me hɔ aba no bi a,
wobehu nea wohwehwɛ
anaasɛ misi hɔ kwa!
Wunnya nea wopɛ no a,
ebeyi w’abufuw ara!
Afe rekɔ, afe reba, n.a

Anka wubese: Dua no
nyemma hwee; nti twa kyene!
Mabɛhwehwɛ aba wɔ so,
na minnyaa bi koraa ɛ,
Owu, fa wo atwapo bra;
twa kyene na fa yɛ gya.
Afe rekɔ, afe reba, n.a

Nanso m’Agyenkwa pa no se:
Ma ensi hɔ saa afe yi!
Mɛbɔ no ho mmɔden yiye,
ebia ɛbɛsow bi,
na sɛ ansow afe yim a,
ɛno de sɛ wopɛ a, twa!
Afe rekɔ, afe reba. n.a

O, me Yesu, kanyan me ɛ,
ma menyɛ ye, saa afe yi.
Ma wo Honhom baninhahyɛ
nni me honam so tumi!
W’ahoɔden ne wo nhyira
na hwie gu me so ara!
Afe rekɔ, afe reba. n.a

Soro nsoromma nantew,
ɛnenam n’akwan so.
Wɔnantew wɔ kommyɛ mu,
nanso wonnyina da.

Saa na wiase rekɔ;
ehwim kɔ sɛ agyan.
Afe yi nso resen kɔ,
na ɛretwam ntɛm so.

Bere twam sɛ as’rɔkye,
ɛsen kɔ ntɛm ara.
Saa na yɛn nso yɛretwam
akɔ yɛn ‘botan ho.

‘Botan bɛn n’ebegye yɛn
wɔ yɛn aguan yi mu?
yɛn Nyame ne ‘Botan no,
ɔno n’otim hɔ daa.

Yesu din no mu nkutoo
na hintabea wɔ.
Sɛ yɛn nna retwam kɔ a,
yɛn ani da no so.

Ɔno na yɛaso no mu,
ɔno na yɛdɔ no.
Yɛbɛbata no ho daa,
na wama yɛn daa nkwa.

O, Yesu, fa wo nkwa no
bɛhyɛ me mu dennen,
na ma minwu wɔ wo mu.
Wo so na m’anida.

O, me Yehowa Nyankopɔn,
ma minhu me nna kan
na memfa me koma mma wo,
na m’ayɛ nyansafo.

Me Wura ne m’Agyenkwa pa
yɛ me wo ba bio.
Nyansa ne nimdeɛ bɛyɛ
m’asetena mfiase.

O, fi w’ahummɔbɔ no mu
bɛkyekye me werɛ.
Ma memmɛyɛ wo de bio
wɔ w’animka akyi.

Sakra me, na ma me ho ntew,
na fa daa nkwa kyɛw no
hyɛ me ti na yɛ me kronkron,
wɔ w’ahenni mu hɔ.

Sɛ me wiase nna to twa,
na m’awiei du a,
ma minhu wo sɛ me Gyefo
akyiri nna no mu.

Agya, nnawɔtwe yi da kan,
na m’aba w’anim ha yi.
Mesrɛ sɛ, ma menkɔ anim,
na yɛ me Boafo pa.
M’ani gyina wo daa nyinaa,
wɔ me nneyɛe nyinaa mu,
m’ahomegye bere mu,
me Yesu, woka me ho.

Awurade, ma menkae sɛ
wo ne wo mma wɔ hɔ daa,
na wo honhom aniwa no,
nenam wɔn nyinaa ‘ra so
wɔn nsusuwii ne adwenem.
Ose ɛne ɔyɔ mu nso,
yegu w’anim adagyaw;
ma yɛn ho nyɛ wo fɛ daa.

Sɛ nipadua akwaa bi
rebegyigye me ara
ama m’ahwe ase birim,
ma minyi no akwa bi,
na m’abrabɔ nyinaa ara
asɔ w’ani daa Awura!
Na da biara nneyɛe
asɔ me Wura ani.
Ɛno de afei me ne wo
bɛbɔ anammɔn ara;
m’amane ne m’anigye no,
me Yesu, ɛyɛ wo de.
M’asefi ne m’awiei no,
hyira me nsam nnwuma no so.
Yesu, yɛ m’ade nyinaa
kosi daa nkwa awiei.

title: Yɛn Wura pa, nhyira nka wo

stanzas.body:
Yɛn Wura pa, nhyira nka wo
sɛ yɛn anantew nantew
de yɛn asi awiei pa,
efisɛ wobɛn yɛn daa.
Wone yɛn nkwa Asuti no,
ɛno mu na yenya nhyira
wo nkyɛn na yɛbɛtena daa.

Sɛ Yɛkan yɛn nna ne yɛn mfe,
na yɛhwɛ ne dodow a,
ɛma yɛn ani gyina mpo
sɛ yɛpɛ wo nkyɛn aba.
Fam nnwuma a ɛma owu
na ahyɛ yɛn honhom mu ma,
nanso woma yɛn daa nkwa.

Wo dɔ no kanyan yɛn koma,
ɛdɛw yɛn mu sɛ ogya;
ɛma yɛn adwene nyinaa
sakra dan yɛ sɛ wo de.
Ɛnde afei wotena yɛn mu
na ɛma yɛn nso tena wo mu
na ɛma yetim wo mu.

O, da bɛn mpo na w’ankasa
bɛba ama yɛahu wo?
Yɛn koma pere hwehwɛ wo;
yɛrenkyɛ wɔ honam mu.
Bra ntɛm wɔ anuonyam mu
hyia yɛn sɛ w’ayɛforo;
wo ara na yɛretwɛn.

Nanso bere a ɛsɛ no,
wo nsam ara na ɛwɔ;
woka kyerɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnwɛn,
efisɛ yennim dɔn no.
Sɛ yɛda yɛn ho so wɛn a,
ɛbɛyɛ w’anigye ampa.
Hyɛ yɛn den na yɛawɛn sa.

Anigye ahyɛ yɛn komam’ ma;
obi rensiw ano da
Yɛka na nnipa ate sɛ
woayɛ yɛn w’ayɛforo.
Yɛyɛ wo de, enti da bi
wobɛba abehyira yɛn
de yɛn akɔ w’ahennim.

O, Yesu, yɛn koma wɔ wo,
na ɛne wo wɔ soro.
Wo dɔ no kanyan yɛn koma,
na ɛtwe yɛn kɔ wo nkyɛn.
Enti bere nyinaa mu no,
yɛwɔ gyidi yɛn Yesu mu;
ne mu na yɛn nkwagye wɔ.

title: Da baako twam, da baako ba

stanzas.body:
Da baako twam, da baako ba,
saa na Adam mma no wui.
Tumi Wura no nnyaw obi.
Hena n’obeguan n’anim?
Munim ɔbaako a w’adi
owu tumi so nkonim?
Ɔyɛ Yesu a wasɔre.
Ɔbɛma m’asɔre bi.
Enti sɛ wiase nnepa,
nna, asram, ne mfe nyinaa
guan twa me ho kɔ koraa a,
mɛfam me Yesu ho daa
akosi akyiri nna mu.
Mede me ho bɛma no.
Me Wura bɛhwɛ me so daa
akosi sɛ ɔbɛba.

Momma yɛn ani nnye
sɛ yɛyɛ mmofra yi,
Agyenkwa dɔ yɛn sɛ;
ma yɛnnɔ no bi,
na momma yɛmfa anigye
nsua Anyamesɛm yiye,
na Yesu no de ne nhyira
agu yɛn so ara.
Momma yɛn ani nnye.
Sɛ yɛyɛ mmofra yi,
Agyenkwa dɔ yɛn sɛ;
ma yenni n’akyi.

Mo mmofra mmɛto dwom:
Halleluya! Amen!
Munyi Kristo ayɛ;
Halleluya! Amen!
Munfi mo koma mu,
na momma mo nne so;
ayeyi n’ɛsɛ no:
Halleluya! Amen.

Monkɔ so nyi n’ayɛ;
Halleluya! Amen!
N’ayeyi to rentwa;
Halleluya! Amen!
S’ro ahemmam mu hɔ,
yɛbɛkae ne papa,
na yɛato ne dwom se:
Halleluya! Amen.

Wɔama yɛahu Yesu dɔ,
na yɛkan n’asɛmpa no,
ɛma yehu soro kwan.
Ayeyi yɛ Nyame de.
Tie, tie, tie, n.a.

Mo mmofra nyinaa ara
mommra mmɛto dwom no bi;
momma mo nne so ara,
na mo dwom nkodu soro.
Tie, tie, tie, n.a.

title: Mo mmofra, mommra mmeyi Yesu ayɛ

stanzas.body:
Mo mmofra, mommra mmeyi Yesu ayɛ,
na mmofra nom aseda bɛyɛ no fɛ!
Ɔsoro abɔfo, woyi n’ayɛ daa,
nanso otie mmofra wɔ wiase ha.

Mmofra Da
ne nnamfo ne nyansakyerɛfo nso bi.

Saa nyansa no, emfi onipa bi t’rim,
na ɛyɛ nokware ne Nyame asɛm;
Yesu na ɔnam so frɛ yɛn ba ne nkyɛn
pɛ sɛ yɛte, na yɛn ho atɔ yɛn daa.

Na enti momma yɛn nyinaa mmɔ mmɔden
mmesua b’ribiara wɔkyerɛ yɛn,
na yɛahu Agyenkwa ho nyansa no yie,
na yɛanya ne nkyɛn hɔ daapem anigye.

title: Ka Yesu ho nsɛm kyerɛ me

stanzas.body:
Ka Yesu ho nsɛm kyerɛ me,
mepɛ atie.
Sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ nnɛ a, anka
mebisa no
ne nsɛm a ɔkae
Nasaret hɔ.
Ka Yesu ho nsɛm
mepɛ atie.

Ka me sɛnea ohyiraa
mmofra nkumaa;
mepɛ sɛ obehyira me
te sɛ wɔn nso.
Ka me ne dɔ no
ne n’ayamye.
Ka Yesu ho nsɛm,
mepɛ atie.

Minim sɛ Yesu dɔ me;
n’asɛm n’ɛkyerɛ me saa.
Ɔdɔ yɛn mmofra nyinaa,
efisɛ oye papa.
Yiw, Yesu dɔ me,
Yiw, Yesu dɔ me,
Yiw, Yesu dɔ me
n’asɛm kyerɛ me saa.

Minim sɛ Yesu dɔ me;
ɔdɔ me, ɔhwɛ me so,
ɔbɛpopa me bɔne.
Mo mmofra, mommra ne nkyɛn.
Yiw, Yesu dɔ me, n.a.

Minim sɛ Yesu dɔ me;
ɔbɛka me ho wɔ ha.
Da bi ɔde me bɛkɔ
akɔtena ne nkyɛn hɔ daa.
Yiw, Yesu dɔ me, n.a.

Yesu Krist’ yɛda w’ase
yɛn Agyenkwa pa!
Wo na wohwɛ yɛn yiye
nnɛ ne daa nyinaa.
Yɛda w’ase.
Yɛn mmofra nketewa yi,

Mmofra Da
yɛde yɛn afɔre ba
bɛda w’ase.

Yenni sika ne dwetɛ,
wo ara wunim;
nanso yɛwɔ biribi,
yɛde ba w’anim.
Awurade pa,
ɛne yɛn koma ara;
na sɛnea ɛte no,
dom gye no sa.

Yɛn koma yi, bɔne wom,
na ɛhaw yɛn daa;
na yɛsrɛ wo, gye yɛn wom,
na tew mu koraa.
Fa wo nnepa
bɛhyɛ bɔne no ananm,
ma yɛn wo honhom pa no
ɛnnɛ ne daa.

Yɛma yɛn ani so daa
de serew hwɛ soro.
Yɛde mmɔdenbɔ ara
pere kɔ yɛn anim.

Yɛde nidi ma Nyame
sɛ ne din yɛ kronkron.
Yeyi yɛn dɔ adi daa,
brɛ yɛn ho ase wom.

Yɛbɔ mmɔden daa nyinaa
sɛ yɛne Yesu nam.
Ɛyɛ yɛn fɛ daa nyinaa
sɛ yɛka yɛn ho bom.

Nea ɛsan akyi no,
yeyi yɛn ho fi ho.
Yɛpere daa nyinaa sɛ
yɛbɛyɛ hotefo.

Awurade, yɛsrɛ daa sɛ,
dom tie yɛn mpaebɔ.
Ma yennu wo soro hɔ.
kurow kronkron no mu.

Nyankopɔn abɔfo
som no wɔ soro,
nanso ɔhwɛ nnipa
wɔ asase so.

Yɛn mmofra wɔ hɔ yi,
ɔhwɛ yɛn so daa;
ɔhwɛ yɛn awia
ɛne anadwo.

Ɔma yɛn yɛn nanom
ne yɛn agyanom;
ɔma yɛn yɛn honam,
yɛn kra ne honhom.

Ɔma yɛn mframa pa,
aduan ne nsu;
na ɔma yɛn ntama,
kɛtɛ ne adan.

Ɔma yɛn Agyenkwa
ne Anyamesɛm,
ne kyerɛkyerɛfo
sɛ yɛmmra ne nkyɛn.

Nyame pɛ yɛn yiye,
Yesu dɔ yɛn sɛɛ;
enti yɛda n’ase,
na yedi n’akyi.
Mmofra Da

title: Meba Yesu nkyɛn a, obegye m’ani

stanzas.body:
Meba Yesu nkyɛn a, obegye m’ani.
Sɛ me werɛ ahow a, ɔbɛkyekye.
Meba Yesu nkyɛn a,
me ho bɛtɔ me,
ɔde odwo frɛ mmofra
nkumaa sɛ me.

Meba Yesu nkyɛn a, obetie me.
Ɔdɔ me yiye, ɔsoa me bɔne.
Meba Yesu nkyɛn a,
n.a.

Meba Yesu nkyɛn a, obeso me nsa
agya me akɔ asase pa bi so.
Meba Yesu nkyɛn a,
n.a.

Yesu, hwɛ wo mmofra nkumaa;
wotɔɔ wɔn aboɔden,
na woma wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu
wɔ wo din kronkron no mu.
Hwɛ, wɔn nyinaa aba ha nnɛ;
wɔabehyia wɔ w’anim.
W’asɛm no na ɛka sɛ,
wode ahoɔden ahyɛ
mmofra nketewa anom
ɛno na aba mu yi.

Hwɛ wo mma asafo kuw no,
wɔahyia wo nan ase
rebetie w’asɛmpa no;
hwɛ wɔn sɛnea ɛsɛ.
Sɛnea woaka ato hɔ
wɔ w’asɛmpa no mu sɛ:
Momma mma nkumaa no kwan,
na wɔmmra me nkyɛn, efisɛ
soro ahenni wɔ wɔn.
Ɛno nti wuhyiraa wɔn.

Yi w’apɛde adi kyerɛ
awofo ne mma nyinaa.
Sɛ obi to hintidua
wo kyerɛkyerɛ mu a,
wobebu no fɔ wɔ w’anim
wɔ akyiri nna no mu.
Ɔbɛkwati ne nhyira
wɔ Nyame kronkronbea hɔ.
Yesu, dom ma menka sɛ:
Gye me ne nnipa nyinaa.
Mmofra Da

Awurade, siw nnaadaasɛm
ne nsisi nyinaa ano,
efisɛ wo mma di akyi,
na ama wɔahwe ase.
W’asafo a woagye wɔn no,
hyɛ wɔn den, na wonnyina.
Ma wonni ɔko mu nim,
na wonni ahurusi daa.
Wɔn ayeyi ara nen;
bɔ wɔn ho ban sɛ wo mma.

Apam a wone yɛn pamee
wɔ yɛn asubɔ mu no,
ɛno ara na yɛkae nnɛ
sɛ ayɛ fof’ro bio.
Ma yɛn nyinaa nyɛ wo mmofra,
na yenyi wo din ayɛ
wɔ kasa ne nneyɛe mu.
Ma yɛn suban nyinaa ho ntew,
na wosan ba bio a,
yɛahu wo ne w’anu’nyam.

Amen! nidi ne aseda
yɛ wo, yɛn Nyame, de daa.
Di aman nyinaa so nkonim,
wo a wufi Dawid fi.
Wode wo mogya ne wo wu
n’ɛpere gyee w’asafo;
hena na wayɛ saa pɛn?
Yɛda so yera kwan ara,
nanso bere bi bedu,
na aman asɔre wo.

Kristofo, monsɔre,
na muntu ɔsa;
Kristo asɛndua
n’edi mo anim.
Kristo, Sahene no
bɔ atamfo gu;
monkɔ ɔko n’ano,
ne frankaa rehim.
Nnyeso: Kristofo monsɔre,
na muntu ɔsa;
Kristo asɛndua
n’edi mo anim.

Sɛ mudi nkonim a,
na ɔbonsam guan;
enti monkɔ anim,
na monkodi nim!
Mommɔ ose dennen,
muntu asaman;
monkɔ sɛ dɔm baako,
momfa fɛw nto dwom.

Monkɔ sɛ dɔm kɛse,
sɛ asafo kuw;
nea gyidifo fae
na mo nso momfa.
Monko sɛ kuw baako,
honam koro mu;
yɛwɔ anidaso
ne botae baako.

Fam ahenni bɛsɛe,
tumi bɛyera;
Yesu asafo de,
egyina hɔ daa.
Asaman remfa so,
ɛrenhwe n’ase;
Yesu bɔ gyina hɔ,
ɛrensan n’akyi.

Enti mo nyinaa mmra,
monka dɔm no ho;
mommra mmɛka yɛn ho
wɔ yɛn nkonimdim.
Yɛto nkonim dwom se:
Kristo di Hene;
nnipa ne abɔfo
to dwom yi n’ayɛ.

Yesu Kronkron, Onu’nyamfo
Nyame guammaa a onni dɛm,
woyɛ kronkron, wukyi bɔne,
woyɛ me kra Damfo pa:
Woyɛ mm’rante, ne mmabaa a,
wɔn komam tew no nsusuwso.
Mesrɛ wo sɛ mfi me nkyɛn,
fa wo dom tena me komam.

Mede yaw meka me bɔne
ne me kra awerɛhow;
me koma mu fi yɛ tan sɛ,
ɛma m’anim gu ase.
Bɔne pii agu me ho fi,
akɔnnɔ hyɛ me koma so;
na efi me na yam po,
na mmusu yi da me so.

M’anu’nyam ho ahura sɛ;
wo na wo ho wie tew;
wode nea ayera no
bɛma me wɔ wo mogyam.
O, me Gyefo, wunni dɛm bi,
ma me ho nsan me wɔ wo mu.
Guammaa Kronkron, bra beyi
me nnebɔne ne me fi.

M’akɔnnɔ yɛ ad’ru bɔne
a asɛe me mu nyinaa.
Me Kyeame, bedi ma me,
na ntua me bɔne ka!
Sɛnea anka ɛsɛ me;
meyɛ ohianiwa yi!
Wuhwie wo mogya gui,
n’ɛmaa m’akuru wuwui.

Wɔn a wɔn komam atew no
behu Nyankopɔn anim;
wɔn a wɔasɛe wɔn ahotew,
bɛkɔ ɔbonsamk’rom hawm.
Sɛnea m’awosu te no,
mintumi menhyɛ me ho so.
M’agyenkwa bɛka me ho,
tew m’akɔnnɔ hama no.

Ma menhyɛ akode pa no,
na m’ahyɛ m’akɔnnɔ so;
ma memfa nokware gyidi
mentew me komam koraa!
Ma wo Honhom pa no mmɛtew
me honam, honhom ne kra ho;
na menyɛ nipa fof’ro
me nna’di ahotew mu!

Tu bonsam fi me koma mu,
na wanyɛ hɔ fi bio;
yi ne nnaadaa ne nyaatwom no
fi m’adwene mu koraa!
Ma wonhu w’anuonyam no
ɛne w’ahotew wɔ me mu
sɛ akɔnnɔ haw me a,
ɛnde bra besiw ho kwan.

Ma memfa ɔkra ne honam
ahotew minyi me ho
mimfi fi sunsum asafo
ne abosonsomfo mu.
Wɔn a wɔda wɔn akɔnnɔm,
na wɔsɛe wɔn kra ne honam.
Gyefo pa, begye me nkwa
wɔ saa bɔne yim koraa.

Wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ yɛn honam
anuonyam, na ayɛ
Nyame tenabea kronkron a
ne Honhom tem daa nyinaa.
Wɔn a wɔsɛe Nyame fi no,
ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa ara,
na ommu aguamammɔ
sɛ agoru hunu da.

Yesu Kronkron, ma mennɔ wo,
na ma mennɔ wo nkutoo!
Fa wo dɔ a wode dɔ me
tew me kra ne honam ho!
Ma me kwan na ma me mmɛtena
wo Yerusalem fof’ro mu,
na m’ani agye wo ho,
na mayi w’ayɛ wɔ hɔ!

Ɔkwankyerɛfo pa ne wo,
O, Yesu, m’Agyenkwa.
Nokwaredi fam de, minhuu
obi a ɔkyɛn wo.
Ɛhyɛn a mitu me kwan wom,
O, wo na wahyɛ ama me.
Wunim m’akwantu ho b’ribi,
na wuntumi nnyaw me,
:/: na wuntumi nnyaw me. :/:

Wohyɛ yɛn bɔ, na wudi so,
O, Yesu, m’Agyenkwa.
Nokwaredi fam de, minhuu
obi a ɔkyɛn wo.
Hwɛ m’adifi ne fie ba so.
O, sɛ wohyɛ a, egyina.
Mede me ho meto wo so,
wo nko ne me Nyame.
:/: Wo nko ne me Nyame. :/:

Kyerɛ yɛn wo trenee kwan daa,
O, Yesu, m’Agyenkwa.
Nokwaredi fam de, minhuu
obi a ɔkyɛn wo.
Ma memfa nnam nni nokware.
O, ma mensom wo yiye daa,
na me nneyɛe ne me kasa
asɔ w’ani wɔ ha,
:/: asɔ w’ani wɔ ha, :/:

Hwie wo honhom gu yɛn so,
na woahyɛ yɛn ho bɔ.
Wonam adiyifo so kae,
na ɛbɛbam yɛn ho.
Ma wo honhom mmɛhyɛ yɛn ma,
O, ɔmma yɛnnɛw te sɛ gya,
na yɛde nnam adi w’akyi
aka w’asɛmpa no,
:/: aka w’asɛmpa no. :/:

Anuonyam nka Agya no,
Ɔba no ne Honhom.
Wohwɛ wo mma nyinaa so yiye,
na womma bi nyera.
Ɔsorofo, monkamfo no
momma ennyigye asase so
na ‘dasamma nso agye so,
ama wo din no so,
:/: ama wo din no so. :/:

Awurade, m’ahoɔden mu
na mefi masom wo.
Mede komam ahosɛpɛ
bɛto w’ayeyi dwom.

Merenyi mmɔdenbɔ adi
wɔ wiase som mu.
Mede honhom mu ahosan,
bɛhwɛ soro ade.

M’apɛde funu nyɛ wo de,
wompɛ fam ha ade.
Me komam dɔ ano dwo a,
ɛrensɔ w’ani da.

Ɛnde fa me yɛ wo de nnɛ,
na bɛtena me nkyɛn daa.
Me nso mede me ho ma wo,
gye me koma nyinaa.

Onyame anom asɛm
yi me tebea adi,
sɛ bɔne asɛe me pii,
nanso Yesu gyee me nkwa.

Aba a wɔadua no,
efifi wɔ wura ntam
de kosi twa bere mu,
ɛnna wura no ahyew.

Boa me na menyɛ aso,
na w’asɛm nkɔ me komam,
ma ɛnsow aba bebree,
wɔ nyansa ne ‘bra pa mu.

Onyame anom asɛm
yi me tebea adi;
kyerɛ me soro kwan no,
na ma mennantew so pɛ!

Sɛnea mete biara no,
wodɔ me te sɛ w’abofra.
Enti mede me ho ma wo.
Yesu Kristo m’aba.

Sɛ ade pa akye me yi,
me nkwa ne mu ade wɔ wo.
Merenkora biribi so,
fa me koma nyinaa.

Mɛtew meho atena hann mu.
mɛyɛ nea ɛteɛ daa.
Mɛsom wo m’ahoɔden mu,
enti mɛtena wo nkyɛn.

Sɛnea mete biara no,
nea ɛteɛ na mɛyɛ.
Nokware akyi na medi,
Me nkwa Wura m’aba.

Monsɔre nko mma Yesu,
n’asɛndua nsraafo;
momma ne frankaa no so,
ɛsɛ sɛ odi nim,
odi ne dɔm anim nti,
nkonim remmɔ yɛn da.
Ɔbɛka tamfo n’agu,
Kristo yɛn Wura nen.

Monsɔre nko mma Yesu;
muntie n’akobɛn yie,
mommɔ nwura dɔm no mu
n’anuonyam da yi.
Monko mma no, mmanin mma!
Momfa n’atamfo so,
monyɛ nnam amane mu
momfa ahoɔden nko.

Monsɔre nko mma Yesu,
momfa n’ahoɔden so.
Nnipa ‘hoɔden no sua;
mommfa mo ho nnto so.
Nyam’sɛm ne akotade,
wohyɛ de bɔ mpae a,
worenguan mfi amane
ne adwuma anim.

title: Agya pa, tie yɛn mpaebɔ; 3. Yɛsrɛ wo sɛ daa gya yɛnkwan

stanzas.body:
Agya pa, tie yɛn mpaebɔ; 3. Yɛsrɛ wo sɛ daa gya yɛnkwan
yɛsrɛ wo sɛ mma yengow. kɔ nsu a edwo no ho;
Kyerɛ yɛn na yɛnsrɛ nsiyɛ, sɛ yɛte nea awow a,
na yɛayɛ mmarima daa. yebetu yɛn abura.

Yɛnsrɛ asase frɔmfrɔm daa 4. Yɛyɛ mmerɛw a, hyɛ yɛn den,
ne ɔkwan tɔtrɔtɔɔ daa; yɛ yɛn Kwankyerɛfo pa;
yɛn kwan yɛ abon abon a, sɛ yɛn asetena den yɛn a,
ma yɛmfa so anigyem. Agya pa, bata yɛn ho.
Owu ho ahosiesie

Yɛ aso ma ɔsoro frɛ,
ɛno n’egye owufo a
owu Awurade mu no nkwa;
wɔadom no, na wɔahyira no.

Wɔatew no afi wiase,
na wafi ne haw nyinaa mu.
Ofura Kiristo trenee no,
n’ogyina ne Wura anim.

N’amane nyinaa to atwa,
na afei ɔte Kristo nkyɛn.
Hwɛ, n’ani begye dɛn ara.
sɛ wahu nea ɔdɔɔ no!

Afei ɔne ne Gyefo no
ahyia anim ne anim.
Hwɛ, ahosan bɛn ara ni?
Ɛyɛ mma pa akatua.

Nea oguu fam aba pa,
betwa soro de anigyem.
Momma yengu soro aba,
na daakye yɛatwa hɔ nnepa.

title: Yɛn nnipa mma nkyɛ ha koraa

stanzas.body:
Yɛn nnipa mma nkyɛ ha koraa;
yɛsen rekɔ sɛ sunsuma.
Yɛn sunsuma reware a,
yehu no sɛ ade resa.

Ampa, yɛaba ammɛkyɛwa!
Ɛdɛn nti na ayɛ yɛn saa?

Owu ho Ahosiesie
Efi onipa asehwem; 6. Me Gyefo pa, mesrɛ wo sɛ,
Nyame ne nnipa atetem. ma wo dom frɛ mmenyan me

Bɔne ama yɛatew yɛn ho [nnɛ!
afi yɛn Agya Nyame ho; Wo hann bɛtew me mu ampa,
enti yenni ne nkwa bio, na m’abɛyɛ wo hann no ba.
owu nko na ɛda yɛn hɔ. 7. Bɛhran me koma kusuu nom

Na gyidifo de, wonsuro, na pam owu ne bɔne sum.
na wobenya nkwa foforo. Sɛ wiase pɛ sum no a,
Sɛ Yesu hann tew yɛn mu a, me de, mɛnantew hann mu daa.
yehu no sɛ yɛanya daa nkwa. 8. Ɛnna miwu a, mɛyɛ komm.

Na sɛ obi mpɛ no mpo a, Yesu bɛka m’ani agum,
onii no bɛtena sum mu daa, na matetew m’ani bio
na da a awufo nyinaa mahwɛ n’anim ne hann mu hɔ.
benyan no, ɔrennya nkwa bi.

Agyenkwa, me koma wɔ wo,
bere a ɛhome yi;
me tumi nyinaa yɛ wo de,
ma ɛnnan wo de koraa.

Me Yesu, fa me nnɛ ara,
fa me koma yɛ wo de;
yɛ me wo nokware somfo,
na fa wo dɔ hyɛ me mu.

Soma me kɔ nea wopɛ,
nanso dom kyerɛ me kwan;
ma wo dom no nka me ho daa,
na menyɛ setie pɛ.

Ma minni nea wopɛ so,
minni pɛ foforo bi;
miwu o, mete ase o,
wo de ara na meyɛ.

Meyɛ wo de daa, Awurade,
yi me fa ma wo som no;
wo nkyɛn ara na ma mentena,
na me koma nyɛ wo de.

Yɛn mfe resen ara,
ɛrenkyɛ biara
yebefi ha na yɛakohu
wɔn a wɔadeda no.
Nnyeso: Ɛno nti, me Wura
kora me so da no,
fa wo mogya no guare me
na yi me ho bɔne.

Owia fi n’ɛtɔ
sum bere bi bɛba;
nanso yɛn ani da nea
owia rentɔ da.
Ɛno nti, me Wura n.a

Ɔhaw as’rɔkye bɔ
wɔ wiase po so.
Da bi yebedu baabi a
yɛn bo bɛtɔ yɛn yam
Ɛno nti, me Wura n.a.

Akodim na yɛnam,
na yedi ntetewmu;
yɛn nusu ne awerɛhow
betwam wɔ soro hɔ.
Ɛno nti, me Wura n.a.

Awurade da abɛn
sɛ ɔbɛba bio;
ɔno n’owui sɛ yennya nkwa,
yɛbɛtena n’ahennim.
Ɛno nti me wura n.a.

title: So asomdwoe wɔ wiase bɔne yim?

stanzas.body:
So asomdwoe wɔ wiase bɔne yim?
Dabi, Yesu mogya n’ɛma ‘somdwoe.

So adwuma n’ɛma asomdwoe ba?
Yesu apɛde yɛ n’ɛma ‘somdwoe.

So asomdwoe wɔ fam ha yaw yi mu?
Yesu kokom na yenya ‘hotɔ pa.

Asomdwoe nti, adɔfo gyaw yɛn daa.
Nyame hwɛ yɛn ne wɔn nyinaa so daa.

Asomdwoe nti, yennim sɛ ebewie!
Yenim sɛ Yesu te n’ahengua so.

Owu da so yi yɛn nyinaa hu de;
nso Yesu adi wu tumi so nim.

Wiase haw nyinaa betwam akɔ;
Yesu refrɛ yɛn akɔ n’asomdwoem.

Mepɛ matutu hanom
makɔtena Kristo nkyɛn.
M’ani nnye hanom bio.
Mafe me fi pa.

Makyekye m’adesoa,
mawie m’ahoboa,
maso me poma mu nso,
meyɛ masi so.

Ɔkwan no mu yɛ yaw sɛɛ,
enti ma w’abɔfo
mmehyia me sɛ Hagar,
na manni sukɔm.

Sɛ m’ani da wo so yi,
m’ani da obi so.
Wo bɔhyɛ bɛbam me ho
ma madu fie.

Mede ah’rusidi pa
bɛhyɛn Yerusalem.
Mɛnante n’abɔnten so.
Anigye pa ni.

Sɛ wosom w’Agyenkwa
de kosi wum a,
wobedu soro Paradise hɔ;
sɛ woko na wudi emu nkonim a,
wubedi ɛhɔ nkwadua aba.
Onyame mma no, wobedi n’ade;
:/: ɔno bɛkyekye wɔn werɛ daa. :/:

O, Yesu, boa me ma
minni nkonim bi;
ko a mereko yi mu yɛ den.
Minnim me ho so hwɛ yiye koraa po,
enti mesrɛ wo sɛ bɛhwɛ me so,
na begyigye me, na siesie me,
:/: hyɛ me baninha, na minyi dɔm! :/:

Obiara a obedi saa nkonim no,
owuprenu no, ɛrenka no da;
na mmom, owu a, okohu n’Agyenkwa
na n’ani agye daa wɔ daa nkwa nom!
Ɔne ‘hotefo ne Nyame ‘bɔfo
:/: bɛbom atena ase wɔ nkwa pa mu. :/:

O, Yesu, boa me ma
minni nkonim bi,
me gyidi a mewɔ taa yɛ mmerɛw;
enti mesrɛ wo, dom me ma me gyidi,
na ma minso wo tumi mu dennen.
Ma mennɔ wo yie; na minni w’akyi,
:/: na woanya nidi wɔ me mu bi. :/:

Ɛhena na onim ne wuda?
Yɛn nna retwam, n’owu reba.
Enni da bi a wu mpatu mma,
na ɛnto nnipa mpofirim.
Me Nyame, Kristo mogya nti,
ma me ha tena nsi me yiye!

Me Wura, ma minnwen me wu ho,
na ma me kra nna Yesu wum,
ma mensakra m’adwene nnɛ yi,
na manwu wɔ me bɔne mu.
Me Nyame, Kristo mogya nti,
ma me ha tena nsi me yiye.

O, m’Agya, fa Yesu trenee no
bɛkata me nnebɔne so,
na me ho atɔ me wɔ hanom,
na m’ani agye daa wɔ hɔ.
Me Nyame, Kristo mogya nti,
ma me ha tena nsi me yiye!

M’ahyɛ Yesu wɔ m’asubɔ mu,
na me ne no ayɛ biako;
wode me bɔne nso akyɛ me,
agye m’afra wo mma no mu.
Me Nyame, Kristo mogya nti,
ma me ha tena nsi me yiye!

Madi me wura Yesu honam,
m’asan manom ne mogya no;
ne werɛ rentumi mfi me da,
mewɔ ne mu, n’ɔwɔ me mu.
Me Nyame, Kristo mogya nti,
ma me ha tena nsi me yiye!

Ɛnde mete ase, na mewu
wo asomdwoem, minsuro hwee.
Ɛmmra me so sɛnea wopɛ,
na minim sɛ wode wo dom
ne Kristo mogya bewie
me fam ha tena nyinaa yiye.
Owu ho Ahosiesie

Onyame Ba ne me nkwa,
miwu a, minsuro;
ɔno ara de me kra
bɛkɔ nea ɔwɔ.

Ɔsoro hɔ ne me k’rom
na Yesu nso wɔ hɔ;
m’ani begye hɔ daapem,
me ho benya adwo.

Fam ha amanehunu
ne haw nni hɔ koraa;
yaw biara nni hɔnom,
me ho bɛtɔ me daa.

Anka mensɛ ɔsoro
ne hɔ anuonyam,
na meyɛ debɔn’yɛfo
fi s’ro besi me fam.

Na m’Agyenkwa amane
ne ne yaw ne wu nti,
mɛfa wum makɔ nkwa mu;
wama me ho afi.

Wafrɛ me afi sum mu
aba ne hann no mu
abɛka Nyame mma no
ne n’ahotefo ho.

Enti mekɔda n’ase,
na m’ayi n’ayɛ daa;
mɛto dwom mama Yesu,
Amen, ma ɛnyɛ sa!

Me honam a wɔde dɔte
nwenee no n’owu bɛbɔ;
nanso ɛrentumi nsɛe me,
na m’aka anka me hɔ;
ɛnyɛ me na mituae,
ɛyɛ Yesu a owui,
ɛyɛ Yesu a owui,

Me bembu no nti w’asɔre,
na wadi ‘wu so nkonim,
enti me ne Kristo mamfo
di afra wɔ s’ro nohɔ.
Yesu de ne mogya ‘hyɛn m’,
na manya ne nkyɛn atena,
na manya ne nkyɛn atena.

Agya Nyame, meresrɛ wo,
ma minwu wɔ asomdwoem
m’Agyenkwa no hyɛ me bɔ
a,
ɛma me werɛ kyekye.
Nea ɔteɛ no, ɔrenwu,
onya nkwa wɔ Kristo mu,
onya nkwa wɔ Kristo mu.

Sɛ owu reyi me hu a,
ɛnde, Yesu boa me!
Wo akuru ne mogya nti,
ma me wu no nsɛ wo wu,
na ma minnya wo trenee
sɛ atade pa a mɛhyɛ
sɛ atade pa a mɛhyɛ!

Onyame pa, minim sɛ mewu;
meyɛ onipa a menkyɛ ha.

Owu ho Ahosiesie
Ɛha de, minhu daa ahotɔ
ne nea ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.
Na enti dom kyerɛ me nnɛ
:/: nea miwu a, ɛbɛyɛ. :/:

Me Nyankopɔn, minnim me wu da,
sɛ mewu nnɛ ara, minnim.
Na nnipa mma taa patu wu a,
woguan ntɛm te sɛ nhwiren bi.
Ɛno nti mesiesie me ho
:/: ntɛm ara masie me wuda. :/:

Me Nyame, minnim me wubeam,
na owu nsa bɛka me dɛn?
So me wu mu bɛden me ansa?
So mewu sɛ mehome nnam?
Me de, minnim; na ma ɛmmram
:/: sɛ menya me wum abodam. :/:

Agya, minnim da ko a mewu,
ɛne nea wobesie me.
Enhia pii! Emu kɛse no
ne sɛ, da bi mɛsɔre bi.
Me honam da baabiara a,
:/: me fi pa no n’ɛda me da. :/:

M’Agya Onyame, sɛ miwu a,
mesrɛ wo sɛ gye me honhom!
Na sɛ Yesu yɛ me kra nkwa a,
minim sɛ merenka owum;
ne honhom no te me mu nti,
:/: minim sɛ obenyan me bi. :/:

Yesu a woyɛ daapem hann,
wo mu na minya ahotɔ.
Meyɛ asase so hɔho,
na bɔne pii ahyɛ me so.

Meyɛ fam ha ɔkwantuni
Merekɔ soro Eden hɔ.
Ɛhɔ ne m’ahotɔ kurow.
Yesu n’ɔkyerɛ me hɔ kwan,

M’akwantu mu wɔ brɛ ne haw,
nanso m’ahoɔden no sua.
Enti me honhom frɛ daa sɛ:
Me Yesu pa, gye me taataa.

Yesu, me nti wotee yaw pii,
me nti wuwuu owu yawyaw.
Wo mmaa ama manya me ho,
wo mogya ayi me bɔnem.

Me nti wɔbɔɔ wo sotɔre,
me nti na wɔhwee wo mmaa pii.
M’ayaresa wɔ w’akurum,
M’anuonyam wɔ w’asehwem.

Me sukɔm na ɛdee wo kra,
enti sukɔm nne me bio.
W’asɛndua no ho nsɛm no,
ɛhyɛ ɔbonsam aniwu.

Sɛ m’ahome sa wɔ me mu,
na ɔkasa sa m’anom a,
ɛnde bebue m’aniwa,
na ma minhu wo soro hɔ.

Yɛ me hann owu sum no mu,
na sum kabii annuru me.
Sɛ meka m’ani gu so a,
ma menna wɔ asomdwoe mu.

W’asɛndua na ɛsɛ me,
na wo damoa n’ɛyɛ me de.
Wo trenee na fa fura me,
na manna w’anim adagya.

Wo nsam ne wo nan mu
mprɛgoo
na ma ɛnyɛ me ho nkamee.
Wo mfem apirakuru no
na mɛhwɛ de akae wo dɔ.

Yesu, woadi owu mu kan,
enti owu renyi me hu.
Sɛ miwie m’akwantu a,
hiɛ wo soro pon ma me.

Sɛ atreneefo sɔre a,
gye me kra fi owu mu bi.
Ma memmegyina w’anim hɔ,
na mansuro atemmuda.

Fa wo hann no hyerɛn me ho,
na mahyerɛn sɛ owia.
Yesu, dom sakra me honam,
na ma ɛnyɛ te sɛ wo de.

Ɛnna me bo bɛtɔ me yam,
na mabɛka wo nk’rɔfo ho.
W’anim na yɛbɛtena dabaa
ada w’ase ayi w’ayɛ.

Onipa, kae wo wuda
ne wo nkwa awiei!
Owu taa ba ntɛm ara;
wuguan a, ɛnyɛ ‘ye.
Sɛsɛɛ ɔkyena, nnɛ po,
wo dɔn benya adu;
enti, ɔdebɔn’yɛfo,
kae wu na nu wo ho!

Onipa, kae wo wu da,
nanso kae atemmu!
Emu na nnipa benya
bembu anaa ’fobu.
Na wɔrennyaw befua,
na mmom obiara
benya hɔ akatua
sɛ ne bra te wɔ ha.

Onipa, kae wo wu da,
na mfra ahuhufom,
na amma woankɔsɛe kwa.
amanehunu k’rom.
Na nkwaseafo pii pa
hwehwɛ ha anigye;
na wo de, sua nyansa
na hwɛ wo ho yiye!

Onipa, kae wo wu da,
kae sɛ fam ade twam!
Sɛ wopɛ a, wubenya
Ɔsoro anu’nyam.
Agyenkwa Yesu gyidi
na fa so bɔ wo bra.
Ɔkyɛ wo ne trenee bi
ne daa ahomeka.

Onyame, ma menkae wo
ne Yesu asɛmpa,
na ma minnwen me wu ho
minsiesie me koma!
Nea wode bɛma me,
ma memfa fɛw minnye!
na nea ɛbɛsɛe me,
ma ɛno mpare me!

Dom me ma menyɛ ntɛmpa
minnu me ho wɔ ha,
memmata m’Agyenkwa ho,
na minni n’akyi daa!
Owu ne atemmu mu
m’ani da Yesu so.
Fa me kɔ soro hann mu,
na mensom wo wɔ hɔ!

Ɔkwantuni, manante mabrɛ,
na m’adesoa yɛ me d’ru;
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ,
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ.

Ɔkwantuni, m’ayare mabrɛ,
na m’adesoa yɛ me d’ru;
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ,
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ.

Ɔkwantuni m’adwumam brɛ so,
na m’adesoa yɛ me d’ru;
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ,
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ.

Ɔkwantuni, me sɔhwɛ dɔɔso,
na m’adesoa yɛ me d’ru
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ,
na mɛyɛ dɛn makɔ fie?
Nyame bɛky’rɛ

Ɔkwantuni, manante mabrɛ,
mɛhwɛ me Nyame no daa.
Ɔno n’ɔde m’ bɛkɔ fie,
n’ asi me yie
Ɔno n’ɔde m’ bɛkɔ fie,
n’ asi me yie

Ɛhɔ de, nusu bi nni;
awerɛhow nso nni hɔ.
Ɔtemmufo trenee no
bebu nnwuma ho ntɛn pa.
Agya, wo hintabea hɔ
n.a.

Ɛhɔ na ahotefo
aniwa behu Yesu;
wobehu ne dɔ kɛse
wɔ n’asɛndua no mu.
Agya, wo hintabea hɔ
n.a.

Yɛde kommyɛ reka sɛ:
Dɔte nkɔyɛ dɔte de,
na mfutuma nso saa ‘ra.
Yenim sɛ ɔbɛsɔre.
Agya, wo hintabea hɔ
n.a.

title: Me kra, afei Yesu frɛ wo kɔ ɔsoro hɔ

stanzas.body:
Me kra, afei Yesu frɛ wo kɔ ɔsoro hɔ
wɔ ne daa ‘homekam!
Ma wo ho so tu fi fam ha,
yɛ no ntɛm pa.
Yesu begye wo atom.

Afei mikohu m’Agyenkwa, na mahwɛ no
ɛne n’anu’nyam kɛse!
Merenkyɛ wɔ fam ha bio,
mɛkɔ nohɔ wɔ nea me Yesu te.

Fam ha ade mempɛ bio, na ɛresen kɔ;
hwee rennye me asabawm.
Manya nea ɛrentwam da,
ɛtena hɔ daa,
ɛne Yesu anu’nyam.

Mabrɛ wiase amanem!
Ma me gyidi ɛne abotɔase!
Sɛ ɛda a wopɛ no du a,
mede fɛw pa
mɛkɔ makodi dehye.

title: O, Daa Hene, wo nne gyigye

stanzas.body:
Amanehunu to betwa,
na ebenya awiei pa;
ahotɔ wɔ yaw akyi.
Onyame dɔ no wɔ hɔ daa;
wiase amane dɔɔso
nanso n’awiei bɛba,
Agyenkwa no na ɔka sɛ,
me mogya no bɛhyɛ mo den.

Ogya ne nsu ne nkrante mpo,
remma mempa me gyidi da;
ɛrenkyɛ, ɔhaw betwam.
Otirimmɔdenfo renkyɛ;
owu betwa n’adwene so,
na abrɛfo bɛhome.
Ɛyɛ afiase nna a
ɛrenkyɛ; ɔhome bɛba.

Wɔn a wobedi fɔ no de,
wɔn haw gya rennum ara da,
na wɔn aboaa renwu da.
Ɛno nti, wɔbɛsɛe koraa;
wɔn amanehunu wusiw
bedu Onyame anim.
Wobehu yaw ne amane
de akosi daapem daapem.

O, Awurade, wo ho tew pɛ;
woteɛ; w’atemmu yɛ trenee;
wubu bɔnefo ntɛn pɛ.
Sɛ obi antie w’asɛm
wɔ ne nna ketewa yim a,
n’anidaso bɛyera.
Onipa ba, sakra wo ho,
na da bɔne ampatuw wo.

Sɔre fi wo bɔne nna mu;
woyɛ oguan a wayera.
Sakra w’adwene nnɛ yi.
Sɔre, na wo bere adu.
Wiase sɛe nni akyiri;
wubenya w’akatua.
Ebia awiei no ni,
hena na onim ne wuda?

Kyi wiase ne n’akɔnnɔ,
anu’nyam ne ahuhude,
na ɛrefura w’ani.
Fa ɔwɛn hwɛ wo ho so daa.
Wiase nnebɔne pii no
ne ɔbonsam gyigye wo.
Hwɛ hann a apue wo so,
na yɛ ntɛm, na sakra wo ho.

Onipa, wo koma yɛ den,
wunni ti, w’ani afura;
pa wiase akɔnnɔ.
O, ɔbonsam gya mu yaw no
kyɛn wiase yi amane.
So ɛhɔ kɔ nyɛ wo yaw?
Hena na ɔbɛkyerɛ me
sɛnea hɔ amane te?

O, Daa Hene, wo nne gyigye,
ehwirew komam sɛ nkrante.
W’ asɛm tim hɔ daa nyinaa.
O, Daa Hene, wonsakra da,
bɔne ma me koma tu daa,
na minhu nea menyɛ.
O, Yesu, yɛn nna to twa a,
ma yɛmmra wo daa nkwa no mu.

O, wiase, mekra wo,
na woda bɔne mu;
mempɛ wo bɔneyɛ no
ɛne wo nnaadaasɛm.
Ɔsoro n’adepa wɔ
ɛhɔ ye ma me kra;
ɛhɔ na Nyame somfo
benya ‘katua pa.

O, Yesu, fa w’ayamye
betu me honhom fo;
sɛ ɛden me wɔ fam ha a,
bɛyɛ me Boafo;
betwa m’ahohia so,
bɛhyɛ me baninha,
na ma minwu ahodwom,
kyɛ me wo daa nnepa.

Wo din ne w’asɛndua
hyerɛn me koma mu,
na enti me ho tɔ me,
na m’ani gye bebree.
Ma minya wo mogya mu
awerɛkyekye pa;
kyerɛ me w’ahummɔbɔ,
ma enkura me daa.

Wo dom no nti fa me kra
hyɛ w’akuru mu daa;
beyi me ha amanem,
kɔtena wo nkyɛn koraa.
Nea wahyɛn w’aban mu no,
ne ha tena si yiye,
nea ɔte wo srɛm no,
ne ho asan no pɛ.

Yesu, kyerɛw me din bi
fa hyɛ wo nhoma mu,
na ma menyɛ wo honam
akwaa mu biako;
ɛnna me ho bedwo me,
na manya me ho daa.
Ma minnya wo nokware,
minyi w’ayɛ dabaa.

Gyidifo tenabea pa
wɔ nea wɔn Agyenkwa a
wɔn ani da no so wɔ;
wɔn fi pa wɔ soro hɔ.

Oyi kɔ, na oyi kɔ
kɔhyɛn soro man mu hɔ;
wommisa yɛn ansa sɛ
wɔkɔ a, eye ana?

Sɛ yɛn Wura yɛ no saa a,
anka yebese no dɛn?
yɛde nusu srɛ no sɛ:
Ma oyi nkyɛ ha kakra!

Onim ade nyinaa ‘ra,
na sɛ ɛba yɛn so saa a,
ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ yɛyɛ komm
na yɛhome wɔ n’akrum!

Wɔn a wogyaw yɛn mu pii
ma yɛn ani gyina de,
nanso Agyenkwa kɛse,
wo nsa hyia yɛn ara.

Yesisi yɛn ti ase,
su dennen, di awerɛhow
gyam adɔfo wufo a,
Yesu, Maria Ba, tie.

Wo a wofaa yɛn honam,
soaa yɛn awerɛhow,
suu nnipa mma su nso pɛn,
Yesu, Maria Ba, tie.

Sɛ wɔbɔ yɛn wu-dɔn a,
na yɛn kra atu kɔ nen;
yɛn atemmu da so a,
Yesu, Maria Ba, tie.

Yɛn kra de awerɛhow
dwen bɔne a yɛayɛ ho,
ma yɛn ho popo pii a,
Yesu, Maria Ba, tie.

Wo yaw, w’animguase
dɔɔso, nso woanyɛ bɔne,
woasoa yɛn s9 nyinaa.
Yesu, Maria Ba, tie.

Ɔhwɛfo wui dua ho
n’ ɔde ayi yɛn bɔne:
enti sɛ ne nguan wu a,
na wobu wɔn sɛ wɔada.

Wɔnkɔ sɛ mumɔyɛfo
wonsuro weredifo;
wɔte sɛ akofo a
wɔawie ko, na wɔada.

Daa afobu no nhaw wɔn,
wɔkɔ wɔn fam ha piam
sɛ wɔkɔhome, ansa
na Yesu abenyan wɔn.

Wɔn honam da wupa so
te sɛ wɔn homebea,
wɔtɔ nko da sɛ mmofra,
ahometew nni wɔn mu.

Onyame ahummɔbɔ,
ne Yesu dɔ kɛse no,
ne honhom pa adanse
ma wowu asomdwoe wu.

O, Yesu, w’ahummɔbɔ
ayi me wu mu nwene;
wo wu no nti, ma minwu
menkɔ w’ahotɔ pa mu.

Ma memfa gyidi pa so
minwu wɔ w’abasa so,
na fa me nnompe sie
kosi sɛ wobɛfrɛ me.

Ɛnna benyan me bio
wɔ w’anim anigye mu,
na ma minnya wo nkyɛn hɔ
anuonyam ahotɔ!

title: O, Yesu a yɛn nkwa fi wo

stanzas.body:
O, Yesu a yɛn nkwa fi wo,
mefrɛ wo wɔ me wum,
wo hann a efi soro no
bɛmene fam ha sum.

Wo na wopopa me bɔne
m’amanem ne me wum
minni awerɛkyekye bi,
gye sɛ wo nkutoo nkyɛn.

Yesu, w’amane a wuhui,
wo mmaa, w’apirak’ru,
wo mogya n’a wuhwie gui,
w’asɛndua ho wum.

Ɛn’na mehwɛ no wɔ me yawm
na ɛma ano dwo;
Ɛn’na eyi me fi me hawm
ma minya ahotɔ.

M’Agyenkwa pa, meda w’ase
sɛ mete w’asɛmpa,
na sɛ migye midi no nti,
mete mu dɛ wɔ ha.

Sɛ minnim wo a, anka dɛn
na m’ani bɛda so?
N’afei fa me bra wo nkyɛn hɔ,
na gye me tom wɔ hɔ.

Ɔhɔho ne mamfrani
na meyɛ wɔ fam ha.
M’asase mmɛn ha baabi,
minni fi pa wɔ ha.
Ɔhaw, ɔbrɛ, amane
na yɛde tu ha kwan;
n’ɔsoro hɔ na Nyame
bɛma mahome sann.

So mamfi me mmofraase
manhyia haw ne brɛ,
ahoguan ne amane,
ɔko ne ɔpere?
Mannya nea me kɔn dɔ,
m’ani anwie gye;
enti mema m’anan so
na mentena ha menkyɛ

Ɛha amane kwan no,
bebree adi so kan;
Onyame adiyifo.
ne ne man mu mpanyin.
Boasetɔ ne gyidi
na wɔde tuu wɔn kwan;
na wɔn akyi na medi
wɔ nkwa ne wu nyinaam.

Kae Abraham akwantu,
na kae ne nhyira bi!
Ɔhɔho ne mamfrani.
na sua no yɛ bi
Atamfo no, di wɔn so,
amane no fa mu!
Ɔsraani pa nokwafo
bedi nkonim dabaa.

Ɛnde meremia so
makodu kwan n’ase.
Nea sesɛɛ masoɛ yi,
ɛnyɛ me fi no nen.
Onyankopɔn kuro no,
soro Yerusalem,
hann ne ɔdɔ kuro no,
m’ahotɔ fi no nen!

Ɛhɔ na m’ani gyina,
‘hɔ tena na meregye.
Awurade, bra begya me,
na minhu kwan yiye!
Bra bɛma m’anw’ramanbɔ
na me brɛ dɔm to ntwa!
Bɛfa me ha brɛ kwan so
konya hɔ anika.

Ɛhɔ na mɛtena daapem,
menyɛ hɔho bio.
Me ne w’ahotew mma no
bɛtena daa homem hɔ.
M’ani bɛpa akwantum
ɔhaw ne brɛ no so;
me yaw bɛka akyiri;
me ho benya atɔ.

Ma menkɔ, ma menkɔ,
menkɔhwɛ m’agyenkwa no,
Anigyina hyɛ me kra ma,
mepɛ makohu m’Agyenkwa
magyina n’ahengua ‘nim
na mafra ɔsorofom

Me Hann pa, me Hann pa,
omununkum mu Wia!
Da bɛn na medu wo nkyɛn a,
me ne gyidifo nyinaa ‘ra
bɛba abɛhwɛ wo daa,
na yɛahu wo hann koraa?

Dɛn dwom pa a ɛyɛ dɛ sɛɛ,
n’ ɔs’ro abɔfo to yi?
Minya ɔk’repɔn ntaban a,
anka nnɛ metu mafi ha
makodu wɔ k’row mu hɔ
wɔ Ɔsoro Sion so.

Sɛ mehyɛn wo Salem kuro,
sika kurom wɔ s’ro a,
ɛbɛyɛ me fɛ kɛse pa,
ɛrensen me t’rim wɔ fam ha,
ɛbɛyɛ ahotɔ daa
ɛne daa ahomeka.

Medu soro Paradise,
medi n’aba a ɛyɛ dɛ;
yɛbɛmee daa a enni ase
wo hɔ nkwa nnua no ase.
Yesu, fa yɛn kɔ hɔnom,
fa yɛn kɔ w’ahotɔ k’rom!

Owia de anuonyam
awie n’akwantu no,
anantew wiase nyinaa,
na me honhom nso woayɛ
sɛnea ɛfata
wɔ soro pon ano.
Afei woato Yesu ho dwom
ama no ansa na woada.

Mo nsoromma a mohyerɛn,
mode anu’nyam hyerɛn,
moma anadwo yɛ hyerɛnn,
efisɛ moyɛ mpem mpem.
Me Yesu, soro Gya,
hyerɛn wɔ me komam.
Woyɛ me kra Anuonyam,
me Kyɛm, Koma, Ademmude.

Nnipa mma bɛdeda nnahɔɔ
wɔ saa ɔdasu yi mu.
Nanso Ɔwɛmfo pa no de,
osi pɛ wɔ ɔsoro.
Ɔno na ɔntɔ nko;
me Yesu wɛn me daa.
Enti, me koma resi pɛ
de abata me Wɛmfo ho.

Me ne wo ara n’ ɛbɛda,
mede me ho bɛma wo.
Me Wɛmfo, wo na wowɛn me;
wokora me honhom so.
Minsuro amane,
ogya anaa owu.
Nea ɔne Yesu da no,
ɔne no na ɛbɛsɔre.

Abonsam ne ahonhom fi,
mumfi me nkyɛn, na monkɔ;
munni kyɛfa bi wɔ me ho,
me kwan da Yesu komam.
Yɛyɛ ne nnipa daa
na n’abɔfo wɛn yɛn.
Yehowa akofofo no,
wɔn na wobedi nkonim daa.

Me nnipadua a woabrɛ
afei kɔ na kɔhome.
M’aniwa nso,monkɔhome,
na saa na Onyame pɛ.
Nna mu gyidi ne sɛ
Me Yesu yɛ me de.
na nsɛm nyinaa akɔ awiei.
Me Yesu merekɔda komm.

Wɔamene owu nkonim mu,
na owu agyan no wɔ he?
Owu, wo nkonim wɔ he?
Na wo nwowɔe no nso wɔ he?
Bɔne tumi no ne mmara,
:/: bɔne n’ɛyɛ mmara no ti. :/:

Enti yɛda Nyame ase
nidi ne anuonyam mu.
Ɔn’ na ɔma nkonimdi
wɔ Wura Yesu Kristo mu;
ɔno na owu de gyee yɛn,
:/: na ne sɔre bu yɛn bem. :/:

Owu, wo nwowɔe no wɔ he?
Wo nkonimdi a woanya no,
ɛwɔ he owu sum mu?
Onyame ma yedi nkonim,
na nkonimdi amene wu.
:/: Kristo ne nkonim Hene. :/:

Etwa sɛ nnipa nyinaa wu,
na ɔhonam aporɔw.
Nea ɛte ase nyinaa
bewu, na anyan bio.
Nipadua yi bɛporɔw,
na afei woanyan no bio.
Anuonyam bere no,
na ahotefo nya bi.

Ɛno nti na Nyame begye
nnipa nkwa wɔ ne berem,
na me werɛ renhow bio;
awiei no renhaw me.
Amane a me Yesu hui
agye me afi owu mu.
Me wu kyekye me werɛ,
na minya mu anigye.

Kristo na owu maa me kan,
na ɛyɛ me mfaso bi;
manya ne nkwagye no dedaw,
enti mewu anigyem,
na mafi wiase haw mu
makɔ Nyame nkyɛn wɔ soro.
Ɛhɔ na mehu no daa;
ɔhaw nyinaa to betwa.

Ɛhɔ na nkwa anigye wɔ.
Ɛhɔ na nnipa mpempem
adu, na wɔahyia mu no.
Wɔwɔ Onyame anim,
nea Serafim hyerɛn hɔ,
na wɔreto dwom dɛdɛ sɛ;
Kronkron, Kronkron,
kronkron ma
Agya, Ɔba, ne Honhom.

O, Yerusalem ɔman pa,
wo hyerɛn no yɛ me fɛ.
Wɔto wo dwom anigye mu,
egyigye asomdwoe mu.
Anigye ahosan kɛse
ada adi sɛ owia.
Yiw, afei ade akye,
daapem, daapem adekyee.

Hwɛ, mahu anu’nyam kɛse
ansa na me nsa aka.
Ɔsoro atade fitaa,
ɛno na wɔde hyɛ me.
Mede sika abotiri
begyina me Wura anim.
Menya saa anigye a
enni awiei no bi.

Asomdwoe na mede fi ha.
Onyame dom nti,
me bo tɔ me yam, meyɛ komm.
Mede m’ani to
me Nyame bɔhyɛ so sɛ
owu bɛyɛ me sɛ nna.

Minim sɛ Kristo, Nyame Ba,
yɛn Nkwagyefo no,
ɔn’ na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ yɛn
ma yegye di sɛ
Nyame ne Nkwa Kanea
wɔ ɔhaw ne owu mu.

Oyii no adi maa nnipa
huu n’anu’nyam no
Ɔfrɛɛ wiase mma nyinaa
de wɔn yɛɛ ne man.
N’asɛm trɛw kɔɔ mmaa nyinaa
na wɔn a wɔtee gye dii.

Ɔno ne wiase nyinaa
Agyenkwa pa no,
ne hann no hyerɛn wɔ wɔn so.
Ɔno n’ɔyɛn wɔn
Israel ne aman nyinaa
Aseda ne nim wɔ no.

title: Ɔhome pa bi wɔ hɔ ma yɛn

stanzas.body:
Ɔhome pa bi wɔ hɔ ma yɛn
yɛn a yɛyɛ Onyame mma.
Saa anidaso yi na yɛwɔ,
na ɛbɛbam ama yɛn ntɛm.
Me Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo sɛ
ma minnu w’asomdwoe no mu.

Ɛhɔ na yɛwɔ daa ɔhome;
ɛhɔ na yenya ahotɔ.
Ɛha amane haw no dɔɔso,
na Kanaan de, ɔhaw nni hɔ.
Yɛn dwumadim, yɛsrɛ wo sɛ
fa yɛn kɔ saa ‘home no mu.

Ɛha de, yɛnenam sare so;
ɛyɛ bɔne ne owu nko.
Yɛn Wura Yesu, dom begye yɛn,
na woyɛ Yosua ma yɛn.
Wo mma de nusu refrɛ wo
fa yɛn kɔ saa ‘home no mu.

Fa yɛn sɛ wɔn a wogye wo di
na wɔde wɔn ho to wo so.
Wo honhom ma yɛn ani gyina
saa ɔhome ofi pa no.
Yɛde gyidi su frɛ wo sɛ
ma yennu saa ‘home no mu.

title: Sɛ me dɔn anya adu a

stanzas.body:
Sɛ me dɔn anya adu a,
na meretu mafi ha
makɔ Onyame anim yi,
ɛnde, me Yesu, nnyaw me!
O, Yesu Kristo, me wu mu
mede me kra mehyɛ w’ak’rum,
wo nkyɛn na menya home.

Me bɔne so, minnim ano,
na papa bi nni me mu,
na enti me werɛ ahow;
misuro w’atemmu no.
Na sɛ mekae wo wu no a,
ɛno de, me kra nya nea
ɛma me werɛ kyekye.

Meyɛ wo ho akwaa no bi,
enti na me ho tɔ me;
owu, ahohia ne yaw
rentumi ntetew yɛn mu.
Miwu a, miwu mekyɛ wo,
na wo na woafa wo wu so
de daa nkwa no abrɛ me.

Sɛ woanyan afi wu mu nti,
me nso renka ɔda mu.
Wo sorokɔ ma m’ani gye
na minsuro biribi.
Nea wowɔ hɔ na mɛba,
na mabɛtena wo nkyɛn hɔ daa,
enti mekɔ ahodwom.

Minim sɛ mɛkɔ Yesu k’rom,
na enti hwee renhaw me;
na mekɔda, na mada komm,
obiara rennyan me,
gye Yesu Kristo, Nyame Ba;
ɔno ahiɛ pon dedaw
sɛ memmra n’ahotɔ mu.

Me Nyame mede me kra,
me honhom hyɛ wo nsam.
Wode ɔdɔ hwɛ me so,
wɔ bɔ a woahyɛ nti.

Hena so na m’ani da
sɛ obegye me nkwa?
Akra nyinaa yɛ wo de,
me kra nso yɛ wo de.

Wo na wode akyɛ me,
enti san gye w’ade,
na ma ɛntena wo nkyɛn daa.
Wo na woyɛ me de.

Bɔne a asɛe me nti,
daapem gya fata me,
na w’anuonyam no nti,
meda so te ase.

Wo de wo ba no mogya
agu me honhom so.
Me Wura Yesu trenee
bɛma madu w’anim.

Me gyidi de ne ntaban
betu akɔ soro,
me honhom benya nkwagye
ɔdom bɔhyɛ no mu.

Wo Nyame ne me Gyefo
wɔ me bɔneyɛ mu.
Na sɛ me wu da du a,
worennyaw me koraa.

Wote ase, wodɔ me,
woadi w’asɛm no so.
Me Nyame, me honhom no,
mede mehyɛ wo nsam.

Miwu daa, efisɛ owu bɛn;
daa me nkwa twi bɛn damoa.
Obi nni hɔ a nkwa wɔ ne nsam,
na onnim ɔkyena asɛm.
Bere retwam, owu rebɛn.
O, hena na onim no sa?

Onipa debɔneyɛfo no
na owu wɔ ne bɔne mu.
Dua a mmoawa wɔ mu no,
ɛno na ebu ntɛm ara.
Owu a ɛntoo obi no,
ɛwɔ ɔhonam mu ara.

Owu de, ɛnhyɛ ase n’ɛba;
ani nna so koraa n’aba.
Ɛde nnipa kɔ kurow fof’rom
na wakobu wɔn akontaa.
Ahotɔ anaa amane,
ɛyɛ owu akyi ade.

O, awuranom mu Owura,
wo nsam na nkwa ne owu wɔ.
Nea woma ho kwan na ɛba,
yɛn de, yɛpene wo pɛ so.
Ɛnde ma menkae no saa daa,
na matumi awɛn yiye.

Asehwe ketewa bi sɛɛ po,
betumi atwa me nkwa so.
O, me Wura, ma minso wo nsa,
na ‘fei hwɛ Yesu mpata wu.
Me nipadua wu mu no,
ma me honhom mmata ne
ho.

Sɛ mantumi anka asɛm bi,
na mansusuw biribi a,
saa bere yi, nea meka ni:
Owura, dom gye me honhom.
Sɛ meka m’ano metom a,
ma Yesu mogya nka mma
me.

Sɛ awiei tu me koma a,
ɛnde bue s’ro pon ma me.
Twitwa owu nhama mu ma me,
na afei twe me bra wo nkyɛn.
Ɛnde me nkradi renhaw ‘bi,
na ɛbɛma ɔhome nko.

title: Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu

stanzas.body:
Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu
wɔ anigye ne ahotɔm.
Mefura ne mogya ne trenee
te sɛ ayɛforo ntama.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
Ne wu mu na owu yɛ dɛ,
ɛmma mensɛe nkosi awiei,
ne mogya gye nea wasɛe.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
N’apirakuru hyɛ me den.
Ɛno ara de me bɛkɔ s’ro,
na me koma atɔ me yam.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
Sɛ me ho sa a, ɔwɔ hɔ.
Ne mogya n’eyi me ho bɔne,
enti ne ho na mɛbata.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu,
O, Awurade, gye me kra.
Wobɛsɛe me owuprenu no,
na manya me wu mu mfaso.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
Sɛ mannya biribiara,
na nneɛma nyinaa hwere me,
na me koma ntɔ me yam a,
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
Wo, Yesu, na meyɛ wo de,
enti mma m’ani mmfi wo so da,
ma minnya wo nkyɛn ahotɔ.
Me Yesu kyekye me werɛ,
me Yesu mu na medi nim.

Me Yesu nkutoo mu na mewu.
O, di boa me eyi mu.
Hyɛ me wo trenee, na m’adi nim,
na woakum owu ama me.
Wo na wokyekye me werɛ,
wo mu ara na medi nim.

Me koma pere repɛ
daapem ahotɔ no,
na ɛha de, daa mehyɛ
amane bon no mu.
Merepere makra wo,
na mafi haw yi mu
akonya daa anigye.
O, Yesu, bra ntɛm ntɛm.

Wo na woagye me afi
owu ne Satan nsam.
Wode wo mogya tɔɔ me,
wudii nkonim maa me.
Ɛdɛn po na mesuro
ɔtamfo ne ne dɔm?
Sɛ m’ani da wo so a,
mɛyɛ ahotɔ ba.

Wiase nkwa nyɛ me dɛ,
owu yɛ me nwene.
Mete ase me ma wo,
na miwu mema wo.
Wo mu nkwa no ye ma me,
enti gye me honhom.
Anigyem na mede ma,
na ɛyɛ me mfaso.

Nnipadua bɛporɔw,
na ɛbɛsɛe koraa.
Ɛno nti Kristo bɛsan
ayɛ no foforo.
Ɛbɛhyerɛn sɛ ‘wia
n’anya nkwa mmoroso.
Ɛbɛnom soro nsu a
daa nkwa ayɛ no ma.

Wiase ha asetena,
me kra ani nnye ho.
N’anuonyam ahorow
ne n’ahoɔfɛ po,
mibu no ahuhude;
nea ɛrentena hɔ.
Ɔsoro hɔ nnepa no,
n’ɛtena hɔ kosi daa.

Sɛ migyaw mma nyisaa a,
wodi awerɛhow,
na ayamhyehye ka me
wɔn amane nti a,
Mede anigye mewu,
m’ani da Nyame so.
Ɔbɛyɛ wɔn Agya pa
ahwɛ wɔn so daa daa.

Na afei m’Agyenkwa pa,
mɛyɛ wo de koraa.
Ma minwu asomdwoe wu,
na soro abɔfo
de me akɔ daa nkwa a
ɛyɛ wo de no mu,
nea wode w’amane,
wo wu nya maa me no.

title: O, me honhom, ma w’ani nnye

stanzas.body:
O, me honhom, ma w’ani nnye,
na wo werɛ mfi ɔhaw.
Hwɛ wo Wura Yesu frɛ wo
afi bɔne atɛkyɛm.
Worefi amane mu
akɔ daa ahotɔ mu
nea aso bi ntee da no.
Ɛhɔ na wobɛtena daapem.

Anadwo, awia nyinaa,
Awurade, mefrɛɛ wo.
Sɛ me haw bu fa me so a,
ɛnde bra bedi ma me.
Sɛnea ɔkwantufo
hwɛ ne kwan awiei no,
saa ara na mehwɛ kwan sɛ
m’amane ne haw to betwa.

Sɛnea nhwiren pae fɛfɛ,
na ne dua yɛ nsɔe no,
saa na nokware Kristofo
gyina amane mu nen.
Ahum tu, na mframa bɔ,
na asorɔkye huru;
saa na wiase abrabɔ
kura ɔhaw ne ɔbrɛ nen.

Ne saa nti, Owura Yesu,
daapem Hann, hyerɛn me so.
Twiw bɛn me na bata me ho,
ma wo mogya nguare me.
Anigye ne ahosan
na ma memfa mfi fam ha.
Yɛ me nkwa ne me kwan so hann
Na dom yɛ me Boafo pa,

Wo wu kwan ara na mɛhwɛ,
na mafa so mawu bi.
W’apira akuru no nti,
mɛhyɛn soro kurow nom
Paradise fɛfɛ a
woabue ano pon no.
Emu na wode me bɛkɔ
na matena hɔ akosi daa.

O, me kra, ma w’ani nnye ɛ;
ma wo werɛ mfi ɔhaw,
na wo Wura Yesu frɛ wo
sɛ fi wiase haw mu.
Anu’nyam ne anigye
na wubenya wɔ hɔ daa.
Wo ne hɔ abɔfo bɛbom
ato ayeyi dwom daa daa.

O, Awurade, wo pɛ nyɛ,
owu ne nkwa nyinaa mu.
Wo nko na m’ani gyina wo,
enti gye me, na mansɛe.
Wo dom no mu na woagye me;
yɛ me sɛnea wo pɛ te.
Wo dɔ kyɛn ade nyinaa.

Me Nyame, ma memmɔ me bra
sɛnea ɛsɔ w’ani.
Bɔ me ho ban, na ma minguan
kyerɛ bɔne biara.
Ma me nea ehia me,
na ma minnya wo daa nkwa no,
na boa me daa nyinaa.

Sɛ menam wo dɔ nhyehyɛe so
fi wiase yi mu a,
ɛnde hyɛ me anuonyam,
na makɔ no anigyem.
Me kra ne me nipadua,
wo nsam ara na mede hyɛ.
O, Yesu, gye me. Amen!

Nante yiye!
Nnɛ wɔafrɛ wo me ba,
sɛ bra ɔsoro fi!
Yɛn de, yesu, wo wu yi yɛ yɛn yaw
nanso Nyame pɛ nti,
Yensu na yenni nkɔmmɔ ntra so;
na yɛde abotɔase ka sɛ:
Nante yiye!

Nante yiye!
wo Nyame ankasa
n’ ɛfrɛ wo fi fam ha.
Ɔde ne ba afɛm me ha kakra,
n’ afei wagye n’ade.
Ɛnde menham, na minsianka wo;
wo kɔ besi yiye ama wo.
Nante yiye!

Nante yiye!
Wo kyɛfa so kɛse,
na woanya hɔ nnepa.
Wiase ha yɛpere mu nnepa
nanso nnepa no nka.
Na Onyame no nkutoo nkyɛn hɔ
n’ anigye pa ne anu’nyam wɔ;
Konya mu bi!

Kodi yɛn kan!
Wo de, woankyɛ koraa;
na yɛn nso bɛba hɔ.
Yɛn da bedu, na yɛafi fam ha bi
akɔ ɔsoro hɔ.
Mensom me Wura Yesu yiye
na ɔboa me gye me tom a,
mɛba hɔ bi.

Nante yiye!
Ɔsoro abɔfo
afa wo honhom kɔ.
Afei na yɛn Yesu, Onyame Ba
bɛma wo ne daa nkwa.
Wasan wo kra afi honam mu
sɛ ɔnkɔhyɛn n’ahomeka mu
Kodi yiye.

Wo ne Yesu nkɔ fie,
ɔyɛ w’Adamfo pa.
Ɔbɛma ne dom no atena wo so.
Wo ne Yesu nkɔ fie.

Wo ne Yesu nnante,
ɔyɛ w’Adamfo pa.
Ɔbɛma ne dom no atena wo so.
Wo ne Yesu nnante.

Wo ne Yesu nkasa,
ɔyɛ w’Adamfo pa.
Ɔbɛma ne dom no atena wo so.
Wo ne Yesu nkasa.

Wo ne Yesu nkɔda,
ɔyɛ w’Adamfo pa.
Ɔbɛma ne dom no atena wo so.
Wo ne Yesu nkɔda.

Nante yiye me ba,
nnɛ, wɔafrɛ wo!
kɔ soro w’Agya fi
wo Gyefo nkyɛn!

Nnɛ, yɛne wo di nkra;
nnɛ, wɔafrɛ wo!
Woayɛ ammɛkyɛwa,
Nyame n’onim,.

Kodi yiye me ba,
nnɛ wɔafrɛ wo!
Ɔsoro hɔ nnepa,
konya mu bi.

So yebehyiam bio wɔ
asukɔn no so anaa?
Nea nsu kronkron no sen daa.
Nyame ahengua anim?
:/: Yiw, yebehyiam hɔ bio
asu fɛfɛ asu fɛfɛ no kɔn so;
yɛne ahotefo nyinaa’ra
wɔ Nyame ahengua anim.

‘Subɔnten fɛfɛ ano hɔ,
nea nsu pete hɔ no,
yebeyi Nyame ayɛ hɔ,
anigye da no nyinaa.
:/: Yiw, yebehyiam hɔ bio. n.a.

Yɛrebɛn asu no ho a,
yebegya yɛn nnesoa;
obegye yɛn kra, ahyɛ yɛn
’hentade ne ahenkyɛ.
:/: Yiw, yebehyiam hɔ bio. n.a.

Asu no hyerɛn no te sɛ
Agyenkwa anuonyam,
na ahotefo a wonwu
ma wɔn nkwagye dwom so to.
:/: Yiw, yebehyiam hɔ bio. n.a.

Ɛrenkyɛ na yɛadu fie;
yɛn akwantu to atwa,
na yɛate asomdwoe nnwom a
ɛkanyan koma no daa.
:/: Yiw, yebehyiam hɔ bio. n.a.

Agyenkwa no akyidifo
nam fam ha sɛ ahɔho;
wɔfa ɔhaw ne wu mu nso,
wɔn agyinae ne soro.
Wowie kwan no tu,
Yesu yɛ wɔn atuu;
wɔn honam deda fam ansa
te sɛ wɔadua mm’rofua.

Wo nso woatu wo kwan yiye,
wo a yɛhwɛ w’atiko;
wo honhom anya asomdwoe,
woanya wo ho koraa po.
Woaba w’Agyenkwa hɔ,
na w’ani gye no ho;
na w’adɔfo asiesie hɔ
ma wo honam da nwini mu.

Yɛn ani gye sɛ daakye bi
yebehyiam ɔsoro;
yɛn anuonyam bɛda adi,
yɛbɛyɛ ɔman koro,
Yesu ne Henkɛse
na yɛbɛyɛ ne de.
Yɛde Yesu honam sɛso
bedi asase fof’ro so.

Da yiye dɔfo ɔbrɛfo,
w’adwuma no, nnɛ asa;
ahomegye pa mmra wo so,
na dɛw mapa nyɛ wo de.
Nnyeso: Da yie, da yie,
Nyame mfa wo nsie.
Ade asa, ayɛ sum; da yie.

Nusu bon yim kwantuni pa,
woafi ɔyaw ne hu nsa.
Wo brɛ su mmusu asa nnɛ,
yebehyiam ɔsoro hɔ.
Da yie, n.a.

Yesu basa so, da komm,
na Nyame dɔ nhwɛ wo so;
twere w’Agyenkwa kokom yie,
na bɔne bi anhaw wo.
Da yie, n.a.

Kwantuni ɔbrɛfo dɔfo,
w’akwantu awie sa.
Woafi ha asian nyinaam sɔnn,
woafi wiase aw’rɛhowm
Da yie, da yie, Nyame mfa wo nsie,
Di kan kɔtwɛn yɛn wɔ fie.
Da yie.

title: Ɔhome da so wɔ hɔ ma yɛn

stanzas.body:
Ɔhome da so wɔ hɔ ma yɛn.
Me kra a woabrɛ, bra bɛhyerɛn!
Wo fam ha mpokyerɛ dennen mu
wo wia befi ama wo.
Bɛhwɛ Oguamma a ɔde fɛw pii
bɛyɛn wo wɔ n’anim hɔ daapem;
tow w’adesoa kyene, bra!
Ɛnkyɛ na woawie wo ko no,
na w’akwantum amane asa,
na woakɔ homebea hɔ.

Ɔhome a ɛto rentwa da
n’Ɔnyankopɔn de ato hɔ;
ne dɔ kɛse no nti, n’ɔyɛɛ saa
ansa na wɔbɔɔ wiase.
Onyame guammaa pɛ sɛ owu,
na yɛanya ne nkyɛn daa ɔhome,
enti na ɔfrɛ nnipa sɛ:
Mo a moabrɛ, mommra me nkyɛn ɛ,
mommɔ me home ho mmɔden ɛ,
na momfa fɛw ne nnam mmra ntɛm!

Mo a mo nnosoa aden mo,
na moabrɛ no, mommra afei,
na mumfi mo amane bon mu,
na monkɔ mo Gyefo no nkyɛn!
Adekyee wia ahyehye mo,
enti na Yesu ka kyerɛ mo
sɛ: Home pa no, ɛne me.
Ne man ne mo a ɔhwɛ mo so;
sɛ satan pɛ sɛ ɔsɛe mo a,
munnsuro da, mommra ara!

Ɛdɛn na ebedwudwo nea
ɔyare no sɛ kɛtɛ bi?
Ɛdɛn n’ɔkwantuni a wabrɛ
pɛ tit’riw sɛ ɔhome bi?
sɛ yarefo nya ne dabere
n’ɔkwantuni nya homebea a,
na wɔn baanu ani agye.
Na saa ɔhome yi renkyɛ bi;
Oguammaa no wɔ home pa a
wɔde bɛhome komm dabaa.

Ɛnna wɔde afiafi no
bɛba n’anim wɔ anigyem;
yɛn nusu ne yɛn brɛ no asa,
na yɛbɛtena yɛn Agya fi.
Ɛhɔ na wɔto ayeyidwom,
na wɔbɔ sanku di no ni daa;
ɔyaw, ahomete ne wu
beguan akɔ akyirikyiri
na yebehu yɛn soro Hene,
ɔno bɛma yɛamee koraa.

Sɛ Awurade Yesu mma
nam owu mu gyaw yɛn a,
yenim sɛ wɔnyera.
Wɔn Yesu na afrɛ wɔn,
de wɔn rekosie komm,
na wɔrenyera wɔ ne nkyɛn.

Wɔnam wɔn asubɔ so
de Yesu din afrɛ wɔn,
ahyɛ wɔn agyirae.
Wɔwɔ Onyame dom mu
na so yebu no bɔne,
sɛ wɔafi wi yi ase ntɛm?

Sɛ obi dɔ wiase,
na Nyame dom bɔ no a,
ɛnde ɔyera ntɛm,
na owu beyi no hu.
Nyame mma de, wɔnte sa,
efisɛ wonim trenee kwan.

Sɛ yɛn nna yɛ tenten a,
owu ne brɛ haw yɛn pii,
na ɛmma yɛn bo ntɔ.
Na yɛn mfe a esua no,
de yɛn kɔ ahosan mu,
na owu rentumi ntwa so.

Na sɛ obi fi ase,
bɔne bra wɔ pɛyɛ mu,
de gyidi nantew a,
obenya Yesu mpata,
na wawu sɛ abofra,
bɔne bi ho fɔ nna no so.

Mmofra nketewa yi sɛɛ
anya awo foforo,
wɔ wɔn asubɔ mu.
Wɔn ani da Nyame so,
na wɔn atamfo nyinaa
bɛhwehwe ase wɔn anim.

Nea ɔwɔ Yesu mu,
te asase yi so de,
nanso ɛnyɛ ne fi.
Nyame tumi no nkutoo
na ɔnam so yɛ n’ade,
na tumi bi nni ne nko fam.

Wɔn a wɔn ani afi
tumi de wɔn abrabɔ
ma nkumaa bi sɛɛ po.
Nanso Onyame mma de,
wɔwɔ ɔdom ne nhyira,
na owu ntumi nhaw wɔn da.

Ɔde ne mogya tɔɔ wɔn,
ɔde ne honhom maa wɔn,
n’ahenni yɛ wɔn de.
Sɛ ɔfrɛ wɔn fi hanom
de wɔn kɔ soro hɔ a,
ɛnde wɔbɛyera anaa?

Dabida! Wɔyɛ ne de;
n’Agya de wɔn ama no,
enti wɔsɔ ne nsam.
Obi rennye nguammaa no
wɔ wɔn Hwɛfo no nsam da,
na ɔhwɛ wɔn so yiye daa.

Wiase yi da bɔnem,
na ɔbonsam de nnaadaa
ne at’ro sɛe nnipa;
na sɛ yɛn mmofra wu a,
yenim sɛ Yesu gye wɔn
de wɔn kɔ daa korabea.

Yɛn mma wu yɛ yɛn ya de,
nanso yɛn w’rɛ akyekye,
na wɔte Yesu nkyɛn;
ne nsam na yebefi ha
akɔhyɛn n’ahotɔ mu,
yebenya wɔn sɛ mma fof’ro.

O, Yesu, hwɛ yɛn yiye!
Yɛne yɛn mma yɛ wo de;
yɛde yɛn ho ma wo.
Fa wo mogya kronkron no
sa yɛn komam ak’ru no,
na ma yɛn nso mmra
w’ahennim.

Nyame afa ɔba yi,
na ɛnyɛ sɛ wayera;
wafa no sɛ ɔde no
kosie ne dɔ no mu.

Monkɔ, monkotu me da!
Na mabrɛ me fam akwantum.
Na me ne fam adi nkra,
mɛkɔ soro asomdwoe nom.
Sorofo mu home pa
bɛma m’ani agye daa.

Monkɔ monkotu me da,
na mawie me mm’rikatu no;
mede m’akwantu poma
meto hɔ, efisɛ madu,
enti mede me ho mpo
mɛto dam, na minsuro.

Fam ha, menyɛ dɛn bio
wɔ amanehunu bon yim?
M’ahoɔden ana tumi,
ɛnyɛ no n’ɛma me nkwa ‘tim
Fam ahode ne sika,
ɛntena hɔ, na ɛyera.

Nanso makra owia
na nsoromma ne ɔsram nso.
Munkyini mo wim ara!
Metu kwantenten matra mo
makohu Onyame hann,
ɛma mo anim sinsiam

Na makra me nnamfo pa;
minim sɛ mo werɛ how de,
nanso Nyame honhom pa
rekyekye n’asafo werɛ.
Munnsu honam ani ha!
Menya ɔsoro daa nkwa.

Ɛmfata sɛ musu sɛ
me ne mo redi ntetewmu.
Me de, me kɔ yɛ me fɛ,
na medu nea eye mu.
Adehuhu, sunsuma
sene hann ɛne daa nkwa?

Munnyae su, na manya nkwa,
efisɛ minim m’Agyenkwa,
na me nso mewɔ ne fa!
Me ne mo nti, na ne mogya
fii n’apirak’ru mu gui,
me ne mo nti, na owui.

Odwumayɛfo ɔbrɛfo sɛ ne home.
Ɔda hɔ asomdwoe mu.
Ɔbrɛ bebree akyi, ɔregye n’ahome
ne nnae so ɔda mu.

Odwumayɛfo nsiyɛfo sɛ n’ayeyi;
na mmɔden yi yɛ bɔna.
Nyame ne nnipa de nkonim abotiri
bɔ ne ti sɛ amoma.

Na nhyira ne wɔn a wowu Awurade mu,
efi nnɛ de kosi daa.
Nokwafo ne Nyankopɔn wɔ ne bɔhyɛ ho,
ɔbɛma wɔn ahome.

Asase so ɔhɔho
tu kwan kɔ ne fi pa;
ne nsoromma wɔ soro,
ɔhwɛ ne hann ara.

Egyigye, na ɛtwe no
na n’ani gyina hɔ;
na wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no,
wɔagyaw no kɔ soro.

Wɔn honam da ɔda mu;
wɔn da so wɔ nhwiren,
ɛnnɛ afifi frɔmfrɔm,
ɔkyena n’agunguan.

Nsu a ɛkɔ pom no,
ɛsen kɔ ntɛm ara;
ɛpo bɔ n’as’rɔkye no,
afra mu ayera.

Ahenk’row ne mu sika
yɛ fɛ hyerɛn ara,
na dak’ro pɛ, na wɔabɔ
ahenk’row no pasaa.

Na emu hran ne tumi
gyegyeegye, osebɔ,
asankubɔ ne dwonto,
na mframa de rekɔ.

Na sɛ ɛnonom kɔ no,
sɛ kwantufo kɔ nen;
gye sɛ ɔda ne dam a,
na wadu fie nen.

Enti na n’akwantu mu
n’ani gyina hɔ daa
kosi da bi a wadu
hɔ asomdwoem koraa.

Momma yensie nipadua
na yennye ho akyinnye bi,
sɛ da a edi akyiri no,
ɛbɛsɔre, enwu bio.

Ayɛ dɔte, n’efi dɔtem;
dɔte mu n’ɛbɛsan akɔ.
Dɔtem ara na ebefi
wɔ t’robɛnto
ngyigyei no mu.

Ne kra akɔ Onyame nkyɛn,
ɔno n’ɔnam ne dom no so
agye no afi ne bɔnem
wɔ ne Ba Yesu Kristo mu.

N’amane ne n’ahoyeraw,
wawie ne nyinaa afei.
Ɔfaa Kristo honam sɛso,
owui, nanso ɔte ase.

Ne kra renni nkɔmmɔ bio;
ne nipadua yi bɛda
akosi da a Onyankopɔn
bɛhyɛ no anu’nyam kɛse.

Ɛha, ɔte amane mu,
na ɛhɔ de, ne ho tew pɛ,
na ɔte sɛ owia po
wɔ daapem anu’nyam no mu.

Afei de, momma ɔnna komm,
na onsi ne kwan pa so mmom.
Momma yensiesie yɛn ho ‘yie,
na yɛn nso, yɛn wuda reba.

Kristo bedi aboa yɛn,
ɔde ne mogya agye yɛn
satan ne owu nsam ampa.
Halleluya, Halleluya.

Yɛn dɔba, da asomdwoe mu,
kata w’ani koraa.
Wo soro Agya hwɛ wo so,
enti da na da komm.

Yɛn dɔfo Nyame ne w’Agya,
na ɔwɔ hɔ saa daa.
Wama wo agya ne na pa,
ne nea ehia.

Hwɛ, bɔne mu na wɔwoo wo;
nnipa nyinaa saa ‘ra.
Ɛyɛ Nyame abufuw mu,
kan Adam bɔne nti.

Nanso ɔmaa ne Ba koro
fi ɔsoro baa fam.
Ɛyɛ yɛn nti n’ɔba bewui;
owu gyee me ne wo.

Ɔdɔ a ɔde dɔ wo nti,
ɔde ne nkwa maa wo.
Onim wo koma mu ɔhaw,
na odwudwo wo kra.

Wama wo awofo pa a
wɔde ɔdɔ hwɛ wo.
Nyame dɔ a ɔdɔ wɔn nti,
wɔwɔ ɔdɔ koma.

Onyame honhom mmra wo so
na ɛne wo ntena daa.
Onyankopɔn din kronkron no
bɛkata wo so daa.

“Wɔn a wowu Kristo mu no,
benya ɔsoro nhyira;
’wɔwɔ soro ahotɔ no
na wɔapɔn adwuma nso!’
Nea Honhom no kasa kyerɛ ni,
wonya ahotɔ kosi awiei.

Afei wɔadua aba yi
wɔ yɛn fam ha turo mu.
Daakye bi ne bere bedu
na ebefifi anyan.
Na sɛ da no wɔte Yesu nne a,
ɛnna awufo befi ada mu.

Yesu, ma yɛnna yɛn ho so,
na yɛmfa ntwɛn yɛn wuda.
Bɔ koma foforo ma yɛn
na yɛabɛyɛ wo fifo.
Sɛ yewu oo, sɛ yɛte ase oo,
ma yɛnyɛ wo de nnɛ ne daa
nyinaa.

Awufo, monkɔda yiye
wɔ mo damoa mu komm.
Sɛ awiei nna no du a,
Awurade bɛfrɛ mo;
mobɛsɔre afi mo nnam,
na moaforo akɔ soro.

Mo ani nnye, na mo bo ntɔ.
Ɔteasefo no nam
ahobrɛase mu kɔɔ wum
sɛ munnya nkwa wɔ mo wum.
wɔn a wowu ne din mu no,
owu rentumi nsɛe wɔn da.

So damoa bi bɛkora
Awurade mma so daa?
Ne mma a wadom agye wɔn
de wɔn ayɛ n’asafo?
n’ɔde ne mogya agye wɔn
ayɛ soro adedifo?

Dabi, owu nni tumi sɛ
obesiw ne mma kwan da.
Ɔhonam de, ɛbɛporɔw,
na adan ns9 ne dɔte.
Nyame asiesie wɔn dedaw,
n’ɔbɛyɛ wɔn ahoɔfɛfo.

Sɛnea Nyame Ba sɔree
nnansa akyi fii dam no,
saa na ne wiase mma no
bɛsɔre afi da mu.
afei ɔne wɔn behyia mu
ayɛ wɔn sɛ ayɛf’ro mma.

Ɛnde munnya ne mu gyidi
wɔ mo nna tiaa yi mu.
Nna no retwam, na ɛrebɛn
na obehyia ne mma.
Wɔde nipadua fof’ro
bepue n’ahengua ‘nim hɔ.

Sɛ ɔdɔfo bi wu a,
ɔdɔfo bi besu.
Kristofo kura honam,
enti wobedi yaw.

Gyidi ani hwɛ soro
wɔ anidaso mu.
Nea owu afa no,
bɛsɔre akɔ s’ro

Sɛ Yesu yɛ wo de a,
ɔkyekye wo werɛ,
n’ɔma wuhu soro kwan,
na ɛnyɛ damoa.

Yesu yɛ Sɔre ne Nkwa,
enti yesu po a,
yɛda no ase ara
sɛ ɔkyekye werɛ.

Nea yɛde haw ne brɛ
dua wɔ fam ha no,
wo tumi ma efifi
wɔ anuonyam mu.

O, dom gye yɛn sɛ yɛte,
na yɛ yɛn foforo,
Fa wo mogya guare yɛn,
na yɛadi owu so.

Ahotefo, mo nhyira dɔɔso pii;
monam owu so rekɔ Nyame mu.
Mo de, moafi ha
ɔhaw, ɔbrɛ ne amane pii mu.

Fam ha yɛte sɛ nkoa asomfo,
ɔhaw ne ehu twa yɛn ho hyia.
Nea yehu ne
ɔhaw, dadwen ne nkɔmmɔdi ara.

Ɔhome na mugye wɔ mo piam.
Moadeda fɔmm; ɔhaw bi nni mo so,
munnnya amane.
Biribi nsiw mo anigye ho kwan.

Kristo yii mo aniwa mu nusu,
moafofa yɛn nnɛ brɛ yi mu dedaw,
nanso mo aso
gu so te nea obi ntee bi da.

Bra, Awurade, bra bɛsansan yɛn.
Bue yɛn, yiw, na ma yemfi ha nkɔ
yɛn daa nkwa no mu.
Wo na woma yɛn daa anigye no.

title: Sɛ atemmuda kɛse no bedu a

stanzas.body:
Sɛ atemmuda kɛse no bedu a,
Yesu, ma minhu wo sɛ m’Agyenkwa;
ma menhwehwɛ wo wɔ wiase ha,
na ɛda kɛse no antu me koma.

Da no, me Yesu, ɛhe po na mɛfa?
Odimafo bɛn na obegye me?
Me nnebɔne a ɛdɔɔso pii no,
bɛma magyina w’atemmu no mu dɛn”?

Nanso minim sɛ wodom bɔneyɛfo,
na wɔn kra wu de, ɛnyɛ w’apɛde.
Wo wusɔre mu na wubu wɔn bem,
enti me Yesu, dom hu me mmɔbɔ bi.

Ɛnna mede nnam mɛkɔ Nyame anim;
me Wura Yesu bedi ama me.
Ne trenee na ɔde befura me,
na mɛtena ne nkyɛn wɔ ne daa nkwa no mu.

Onyame mma wɔ anidaso
wɔ wɔn wupa akyi;
wɔn kra bɛsɔre,
ɛnna wobenya daa nkwa.
Halleluya! Helleluya!

Wɔde wɔn honam to ɔda mu,
nanso ɛbɛsɔre;
ɛte sɛ aba a
wɔde hyɛ asase mu,
na afifi, na afifi.

Awurade pa, sɛ mekɔda a,
ma mente wo kasa,
na m’ani agye
Nyan me honam fi da mu;
ma me daa nkwa, ma me daa nkwa.

Da no torobɛnto bɛhyɛn,
ɛna soro bɛbobɔm.
Asase nso bɛwosow pii,
na ɛpo atu ahum.

Awufo nyinaa bɛsɔre,
ɛpo beyi n’afunu.
Asase so anikanfo
ne awufo behyiam.

Da no na Awurade Yesu
befi soro asi fam.
Nnebɔneyɛfo besuro,
na teefo ani agye.

N’asɛm bɛpae nnipa mma mu
sɛ dade anofanu.
N’atamfo bedi n’anim fɔ,
na n’adɔfo bedi bem.

Mommra, mo a wɔahyira mo,
ahenni no yɛ mo de.
Mumfi, mo a wɔadome mo,
monkɔ ɔbonsam gya mu.

Awurade, ma yɛmfa ɔwɛn,
ahopopo ne suro,
yɛn ani nna Yesu ba so;
ne ba bɛyɛ aworaw.

Nyame abufuw bɛyɛ hu,
wɔ atemmuda no mu.
Nnipa a wɔyɛ N’atamfo
na wokyi no besuro.
Awurade, kyerɛkyerɛ me,
na menhwehwɛ wo nhyira.
Ma minhu wo soro kwan no,
na mankɔ bonsam kurom.

W’asɛm di yɛn adanse sɛ,
da bi wubebu atɛn.
Nanso wode atɛntrenee
na ebebu nnipa mma.
Nnipa a wokyi wo no de,
wɔn ho bɛpopo w’anim.
Wo nokware asomfo de,
wobɛhyɛ wɔn anu’nyam.

Ma menkae saa da kɛse no,
na anto me mpofirim.
Yɛn nyinaa begyina w’anim,
bere a ɛrenkyɛ mu.
O, wɔn a wobedi fɔ no,
wɔn amane bɛdɔɔso.
W’adɔfo benya asomdwoe,
na wɔn nhyira bɛdɔɔso.

Ɛnde kyerɛ me na minnya
ahobrɛase koma.
Ma memfa adetreneeyɛ
menhwehwɛ wo daa nkwa no.
Ma mennantew wo hann no mu,
na matew me ho koraa.
Na sɛ wopae nnipa mu a,
makɔfra treneefo mu.

Awufo nyinaa bɛsɔre;
Nyame Ba no bɛfrɛ wɔn,
na ne saa nti, wɔn amu no
benyan anya nkwa bio.
Ɔne Nipa Ba no nti,
nnipa mma bɛsɔre bi.

Na ebinom befi da mu
akɔ daa nkwa ne sɔrem;
na ebinom nso befi mu
akɔ atemmu sɔrem.
Sɛnea yɛn ha tena te,
sɛ yɛn wusɔre te nen.

Wɔn a wɔagye Yesu adi
anya ne mogyam trenee,
na ne honhom te wɔn mu no,
benya ne nkyɛn atenaye.
Sɛ wɔn ti dii kan no nti,
ɔrennyaw wɔn wɔ n’akyi.

Nyame honhom na awo wɔn!
Ne nkwa na ɛwɔ wɔn mu;
honhom no benyan wɔn honam,
na ahyɛ no anuonyam
Yesu hann no hran wɔn mu,
na wɔahran wɔ n’ahennim.

Sɛnea yɛn Agyenkwa no
nipayɛ bewie nen.
Yɛn honhom, yɛn kra, yɛn
honam
n’ebenya ne mu nkwa no;
na yɛayɛ Onyankopɔn
ne Ɔhene Kristo man.

Yuda Gyata, soro Hene,
wo na woadi saa nkonim!
Ma mempa wiase fi yi
minni wo, m’Agyenkwa, ‘kyi!
Sɛ wo dɔn kɛse du a,
nyan me honam fi ne dam!

Wɔde dɔte nwenee me honam
na ɛbɛdan dɔte;
na adebɔne
fra me honam nkwa mu de,
nanso m’ani da Yesu so.

Yesu na owu sii m’ananmu,
na wasɔre bio,
na ɔde faa wu
ne atamfo nyinaa so.
Me Yesu no bɛma me nkwa.

Enti na wodua me honam
sɛ b’rofua bi a
ebefi bio;
na me ne Kristo abom
na ne honhom ayɛ me ma.

N’anuonyam na me nso menya,
owu renhaw me da;
na nkwa a ɛnsa da
na ɛbɛtena me mu daa,
m’ani begye, meyi n’ayɛ

Enti na minsuro amoa,
na minim sɛ mɛda
de akosi sɛ
ne da kɛse bedu a,
obenyan me. Halleluya!

Nyame bɛyɛ soro fof’ro
ne asase foforo.
Kan soro ne wim ade no,
de k’rudu betwam akɔ.
Kan asase no bɛhyew,
na ɛpo mu nsu ayow.

Ɛnom na ɛnne kɛse bi
fi soro hɔ bese sɛ:
Hwɛ mo Nyankopɔn fi no ni!
Emu na n’ankasa te;
ɔbɛtena ne nk’rɔfom daa
ama wɔayɛ ne man pa.

Kan amane no atwam kɔ.
Nyame te n’ahengua so;
ose: Mabɔ ade fof’ro,
na mayɛ sɛ mehyɛɛ bɔ.
Nea mifii ase no,
ɛno ma mawie yi!

M’ade a mebɔɔ no kan no,
wɔn nkwa no fi me nkutoo;
sɛ wɔahwere nea wɔanya a,
me na merehyɛ wɔn mu.
Osukɔm de biara a,
ɔmmɛnom me nsu bi kwa.

O, nkwa a ɛnsa da nsuti.
Nyame no ara ne no;
enti nea ɔpɛ nkwa bi,
ma ɔmmra ne nsuti ho.
Nnipa mma abotɔyam
ne wɔn Nyame anu’nyam.

Nea obedi nkonim no,
bedi ade nyinaa so.
Nyankopɔn n’ɔbɛyɛ n’Agya,
na ɔno ayɛ no ba.
Enti ko yiye konya
daa nkwa no mu daa nnepa.

Abufuw no da kɛse no
bɛhyew fam ne wim ade no,
sɛ Anyamesɛm aka no.

Wɔde hu bɛpaem aka sɛ,
Nyame Ba no reba fam sɛ
ɔrebebu ntɛn awie.

Wɔbɛhyɛn Nyame t’robɛnto,
na awufo afi da mu,
na ɛpo ayi n’afunu.

Amansan nyinaa, nkurɔfo,
ateasefo, awufo
behyia Nyame anim hɔ.

Na nhoma da n’anim hɔ a
wɔakyerɛkyerɛw mu nea
nnipa mma ayɛ wɔ fam ha.

Na ɔtemmufo bɛtena ase,
na ahintasɛm nni baabi,
na n’aweredi rennyaw bi.

Saa Ɔhene no anim de,
wontumi nkora hwetɛ da,
ne nyinaa bɛda adi pɛ.

Sɛ odi nnipa asɛm sa,
na onipa gye yɛ den a,
me de, menya dɛn mabua?

Me de, mintumi minnyina!
Hena na minso n’akonguam?
Ɛne wo ara, m’Agyenkwa.

O, m’Agyenkwa ne me Hene,
da no w’anim bɛyɛ hu sɛ,
enti nnɛ fa dom gye me koraa.

Yesu, kae sɛ wo amane
ne wo yaw no, wuhu maa me,
na w’abufu no ansɛe me.

Midi fɔ, na mayɛ bɔne,
enti m’anim agu ase,
na mesrɛ sɛ, bɛdom me daa.

Wone Temmufo trenee de,
nanso fa me bɔne kyɛ me,
na w’atemmuda annya me!

Da no ma memfra nguanten
nom,
na mma memma mpapo no mu!
Na mankɔhwe ɔbonsam gyam.

Dom ma minnyina wo nifa.
na ma minnya w’anom nhyira
menkɔyɛ Nyame man no ba!

Nusu ne awerɛhow da
ne wiase hyew no du a,
ma yɛnsɔre nkonya nkwa daa!

Abufuw da, nusu da no,
nnipa mma fi wɔn adam a,
wɔbɛkɔ wɔn atemmum hɔ.

Agya Nyankopɔn kyɛe wɔn so!
Awurade Yesu, dom yɛn,
fa yɛn kɔ wo soro homem.

Wiase yi nya hyew a,
nnipa nyinaa behyia
Ɔtemmufo anim.
Nyame ne Nipa Ba no,
Yɛn Wura Yesu Kristo,
bebu nnipa mma ntɛntrenee.

Nea wɔyɛe esum mu,
nea wɔde hintawee,
atoro, awudi,
aguammammɔ ne saa ‘de,
awi, nnaadaa ne nsisi
ne ntanhunu bɛda adi.

Onyame mma nneyɛe,
wɔn mpae a wɔbobɔe,
amane a wohui,
wɔn dɔ ne mmɔb’rɔhunu,
ahotew ne nokware,
ɛno nso bɛda adi bi.

Hintabea nni baabi,
na wo bɔne so nkata
na woda adagya.
Atoro rennye wo da,
na nkotompo nni hɔnom,
na wote sɛ wote ara.

Momma yɛnkae asɛm yi,
na yenni Yesu akyi,
na daa yemmisa sɛ:
So ɔpene me nneyɛe?
Sɛnea Yesu pɛ ni?
Mesɔ Yesu ani anaa?

Sɛ wiase nneɛma twam,
na ogya hyew asase,
na nsoromma tutu gu fam,
na mmepɔw ne po fra a,
ɛnde he na wɔbɛfa,
na worenhu hɔ ɔsɛe?
na worenhu hɔ ɔsɛe?

Nanso bepɔw bi tim hɔ daa;
n’atifi korɔn yiye.
Sion, nea soro Hene
akyekye no, begyina.
Bra wo Hene nkyɛn nnɛ yi,
na wahu wo ɛda no
na wahu wo ɛda no.

title: Nna bi reba, na abɛn yɛn

stanzas.body:
Nna bi reba, na abɛn yɛn
wiase behu b’ribi.
Anu’nyam Hene no reba,
nnipa nyinaa behu no.

Nea ɔde ayamye nne
frɛ yɛn nnipa nnɛ da yi,
ɔno na ɔrebebu ntɛn,
na wapae nnipa mma mu.

Ɔbɛyɛ akuw abien
wɔ nnipa mma nyinaa mu.
Ne nnipa ne ‘bonsam nnipa,
wɔn nyinaa benya wɔn fa.

Nea ɔdɔ bɔneyɛfo
tena abɔnefo afa.
Nea ogye Yesu di no,
ne nkyɛn na ɔbɛtra daa.

Ma menyɛ wo suani pa,
nea ɔtwɛn ne Wura,
ne nea ɔyɛ nokwafo
wɔ n’asafo kronkron mu

Yesu, sɛ wokɔɔ soro no,
saa na w’asuafo no huu wo.
Wokɔɔ no wɔ nkunimdi mu,
na saa na wobɛsan aba,
na ateasefo behu wo,
na awufo nso behu wo.
Wode nyam bepue
soro apranaa mu,
daapem Hene.
Anigye ba yɛn yaw akyi,
w’anuonyam ahenni mu.

Sakra yɛn, wo, tumi Wura,
na ama yɛagyina w’anim hɔ
wɔ wo wiase ba no mu,
sɛnea yɛn ani renwu
wɔ wo ne w’akronkronfo anim,
na yɛankogyina ehu mu.
Ma yɛn nyinaa nyɛ sɛ
wo mma a wɔbɛfra
treneefo mu.
O, ma yɛn kwan wɔ wo nkyɛn hɔ,
na fura yɛn trenee ntama.

title: Yebese dɛn? Sɛ yewie yɛn ko no

stanzas.body:
Yebese dɛn? Sɛ yewie yɛn ko no,
ɔko dennen a yɛnam mu no a,
yɛde anigye bɛhyɛn yɛn apon mu,
na yɛde ahosan atena yɛn fi.
Yɛbɛprapra yɛn anan ase tutuw,
na yɛapopa yɛn anim fifiri.
Nneɛma a ɛma yɛn ahotɔ no,
so yɛn nsa bɛka, na atena hɔ daa?

Yebese dɛn? Sɛ hann hyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,
na yɛda adi soro man mu hɔ!
So yɛn nnebɔne ne yɛn mfomso pii no,
renyi yɛn adi wɔ Nyame anim?
Bɔne pii wɔ yɛn ho, na esiw yɛn kwan,
nanso Kristo bɛhohoro yɛn ho.
Ɛnde yɛbɛhyerɛn ama yɛasɛ no,
na yɛnam ne dom so akɔ n’anim.

Yebese dɛn? Sɛ yɛde ahodwiriw,
betie ɔsoro nnwontofo no,
ɛbɛyɛ yɛn nwonwa, na akanyan yɛn,
na yebeyi Nyame Guammaa ayɛ.
Yɛde anigye bedi ahurusi
wɔ Nyame kronkronbea ne ne fi.
Yɛbɛto Halleluya ayi n’ayɛ,
sɛ Kristo de ne mogya adi nim.

Yebese dɛn? Sɛ Kristo dɔ yɛn saa a,
yɛnam so benya soro ahotɔ.
Saa ɔdɔ yi na wama ada adi,
wɔ n’afɔre a ɔbɛbɔe no mu.
Yɛnam gyidi so na yehu saa dɔ no,
na yɛn honhom pɛ sɛ yɛdɔ no bi.
Wɔn a wɔyɛ n’adɔfo nokwarem no,
bɛkɔ akɔtena n’anu’nyam no mu.

Yebese dɛn? Sɛ Nyame de nne bom sɛ:
Mo a wɔahyira mo, mommra me nkyɛn!
Ɛnna yɛbɛkɔ n’ahengua no anim,
na yɛnam ɔdom so ahu n’anim.
Yɛbɛhwɛ n’aniwa mu nusu yɔɔ no,
ne nsa ne nan, ne mfem akuru no,
ne mogya kronkron a ɛsen gugu no,
eyi n’egye yɛn fi owu sɛe mu.

Yebese dɛn? Sɛ da bi Onyame mma
nam ɔdom so kodu ɔsoro hɔ,
faako a nkwa dua ma onwini daa,
‘na nkwa nsu a’ɛnyow dwudwo ɔkra!
Onipa ahoɔden so nhuan wɔ hɔ;
osu, akomatu ne ɔyare,
ɔhonam yaw ɛne amanehunu
atwam wɔ hɔ, na ahotɔ nsa da.

Yebese dɛn? Nea aniwa nhui da,
nea aso ntee da na obi nnim,
na Nyame de asie sɛ daa nhyira.
sɛ ɔde bɛyɛ ne mma nhyira daa.
Enti yɛn bo ntu, na yɛkɔ yɛn anim,
yɛde mmɔden hwehwɛ soro nnepa.
O, Yesu, twe yɛn na ma yennu wo nkyɛn,
ma yɛnyɛ wo de, na yɛ yɛn de daa.

title: Ɛhe na me honhom kuro ne fi wɔ?

stanzas.body:
Ɛhe na me honhom kuro ne fi wɔ?
Ɛhe na me kra benya daa ahotɔ?
Mehu saa kuro yi wɔ wiase a
amane ne bɔne remma hɔ anaa?
Dabi, dabi, ebi nni ha,
na me kra kuro no wɔ soro nohɔ.

Ɔsoro kuro no ne nea mepɛ,
ɛhɔ na mehu nea ɛyɛ me fɛ.
Yerusalem a n’abɔnten yɛ sika,
ɛhɔ na me kra benya ne fi ana?
Yiw, yiw, yiw, yiw, ɛno nkutoo
bɛma me kra home ne daa ahotɔ.

Ahotɔ wɔ yɛn Yesu nkyɛn hɔ ampa;
owu, yaw ne bɔne remma hɔ koraa.
Ɔsorofo de sankubɔ ne dwonto
behyia me agye me akɔ wɔn mu.
Daa, daa, daa, daa daa, ahotɔ
wo, Yesu wo nko mu na menya wɔ hɔ.

title: Nsanku pem ne nne horow nso

stanzas.body:
Nsanku pem ne nne horow nso
to dwom yi Nyame ayɛ daa.
Agyenkwa no n’odi Hene
ma sorofo ani gye.
Ɔte n’ahengua so soro!
Yesu nko na odi Hene!
Halleluya! Halleluya!
Yesu n’odi Hene daa.

Awurade, Anu’nyam Hene,
wubedi Hene daa daa!
Na b’ribi rentumi ntete
w’adɔfo mfi wo dɔ ho,
w’adɔfo na woahyɛ wɔn sɛ
wommehu w’anim ɔssoro.
Halleluya! Halleluya!
Wobehu wo soro hɔ.

Agyenkwa, ma anu’nyam yi
mmra ntɛm pa, yɛhwɛ no kwan.
N’atemmuda yi nya du a,
s’ro ne fam betwam akɔ.
Ɛna yɛde sika nsanku
bɛto w’ayeyi nnwom horow.
Halleluya! Halleluya!
anu’nyam wɔ soro hɔ.

Ɔman pa Yerusalem,
kronkronfo bɛtena wo mu;
wobehu Awurade hɔ
de aseda ama no.

Yesu wu maa wiase
na enti ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ
yɛn nso yedi n’akyi daa
de kosi yɛn wu da mu.

Wiase nyɛ yɛn de bi,
yɛnam mu sɛ ahɔho,
yennim nea yɛrekɔ;
bɔne aduru yɛn sum.

Yesu, yɛ yɛn kwan so hann
ne yɛn honhom aniwa;
ma yenhu wo soro kwan,
na yɛaba w’anu’nyam mu.

Yenni fi pa asase so,
enti yɛrenkyɛ wiase.
Nea n’ani da soro no,
renni nkɔmmɔ ade bi ho.

Yenni fi pa asaase so;
yɛte ha sɛ akwantemfo.
Ɔsoro na yɛn ani da,
ɛhɔ na ɛyɛ yɛn fi pa.

Yenni fi pa asase so,
yɛte hanom sɛ ahɔho.
Asase so adenyade
remma yɛn kra daa ahotɔ.

Asomdwoe man na yɛhwehwɛ
akwantufo ahotɔ man;
sɛ anka minya ntaban a,
mede metu makɔ hɔnom.

Me kra, yɛ komm, na twɛn
Nyame,
ne bere a wahyɛ bedu;
ma menyɛ ne de wɔ hanom,
na wama madwudwo me ho.

Nyame kurow yɛ fɛ,
ɛso bi nni ha;
Anyamsesɛm ka sɛ:
Ɛhɔ ne yɛn fi.

N’abɔnten yɛ sika,
n’apon yɛ dwetɛ,
n’ahwehwɛ asase,
hena n’ ɔpɛ hɔ?

Ne wia ne Nyame,
foforo nni hɔ.
Adesae sum nni hɔ,
ɛhɔ hyerɛn daa.

Ɛhɔ na nkwa nsu wɔ;
osukɔm nni hɔ.
Abodoo a nkwa wom,
na wodi mee daa.

Ne mma ahotefo,
bɔne nni wɔn mu.
Wɔbɛsom wɔn Nyame
wɔ n’anim hɔ daa.

Soro hɔ nnepa no,
ebi nni fam ha.
Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ hɔ,
benya nnepa no.

Hena n’ɔpɛ hɔnom
ne mu anu’nyam?
Ɛyɛ ne mogya mu
ɔtreneeni no.

Yesu de ne mogya
abue hɔ kwan.
Ɛyɛ ne mogya no
na atew yɛn ho.

Damfo, bra ma yɛnkɔ
Yesu Kristo nkyɛn.
Yerusalem hɔ na
yɛbɛyɛ ne mma.

Soro k’row nom daa ahotɔ,
me koma pere repɛ,
k’row nom hɔ na anigye wɔ,
na nnepa bɛyɛ yɛn fɛ.
Soro k’row nom daa ahotɔ,
me koma pere repɛ,
pere repɛ, pere repɛ
repɛ ne fi, soro k’row no.

Soro fie daa ahotɔ,
ɛso bi nni wiase;
k’row nom hɔ na s’ro abɔfo
ne kronkronfo yi n’ayɛ.
Soro k’row nom daa ahotɔ
me koma pere repɛ. n.a.

Soro k’row nom anigye no,
ɛmmaa bi koma mu da;
fam amane bi nni hɔnom,
na nkwa abu so ara.
Soro k’row nom daa ahotɔ,
me koma pere repɛ. n.a.

Soro k’row no, me fi pa nen;
mepɛ wo mu hɔ maba
mabehu me soro Agya
ne m’Agyenkwa no ara.
Soro k’row nom daa ahotɔ,
me koma pere repɛ. n.a.

Nyame ahengua no ho na
ne mma mpempem gyina.
Nyame de wɔn bɔne af’ri,
ahotɔfo kuw nen.

title: Ye servants of God! your Master proclaim

stanzas.body:
God ruleth on high, almighty to save ;
And still he is nigh — his presence we have :
The great congregation his triumph shall
sing,
Ascribing salvation to Jesus, our King.

Salvation to God, who sits on the throne !
Let all cry aloud, and honor the Son:
The praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,
Fall down on their faces and worship the
Lamb.

Then let us adore, and give him his right,
All glory and power, and wisdom and might.
All honor and blessing, with angels above.
And thanks never ceasing, and infinite love.

Before Jehovah's awful throne,
Ye nations, bow with sacred joy :
Know that the Lord is God alone ;
He can create, and he destroy.

His sovereign power, without our aid,
Made us of clay, and formed us men :
And when, like wandering sheep, we strayed,
He brought us to his fold again.

We are his people, we his care.
Our souls, and all our mortal frame :
What lasting honors shall we rear,
Almighty Maker! to thy name?

We'll crowd thy gates with thankful songs :
High as the heavens our voices raise ;
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues.
Shall fill thy courts with sounding praise.

Wide as the world is thy command.
Vast as eternity, thy love ;
Firm as a rock thy truth must stand.
When rolling years shall cease to move.

title: Ye nations round the -earth, rejoice

stanzas.body:
Enter his gates with songs of joy ;
With praises to his courts rei^air :
And make it your divine employ
To pay your thanks and honors there.

The Lord is good, the Lord is kind :=
And the whole race of man shall find
His truth from age to age endure.

title: All people that on earth do dwell

stanzas.body:
All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice :
Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell;
Come ye before him and rejoice.

Oh, enter then his gates with praise,
Approach with joy his courts unto
Praise, laud and bless his name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

Because the Lord our God is good.
His mercy is for ever sure :
His truth at all times firmly stood.
And shall from age to age endure.

title: From all that dwell below the skies

stanzas.body:
From all that dwell below the skies,
Let the Creator's praise arise :
Let the Redeemer's name be sung
Through every land, by every tongue.

title: To God, the great, the ever-blessed

stanzas.body:
Who knows the wonders of thy ways ?
Who shall fulfill thy boundless praise ?
Blessed are the souls that fear thee still.
And pay their duty to thy will.

Remember what thy mercy did
For Jacob's race, thy chosen seed :
And, with the same salvation, bless
The meanest suppliant of thy grace.

Oh ! may I see thy tribes rejoice,
And aid their triumi^hs with my voice :
This is my glory. Lord, to be
Joined to thy saints, and near to thee.

title: USE ye the Lord, exalt his name

stanzas.body:
USE ye the Lord, exalt his name,
Qiile in his earthly courts ye wait,
Ye saints that to his house belong,
Or sta^d attending at his gate.

Through every age the Lord declares
His name, and breaks th' oppressor's rod ,
He gives his suflering servants rest,
And will be known th' Almighty God.

review: first stanza number missing in scan

stanzas.body:
Around the Saviour's lofty throne,
Ten thousand times ten thousand sing,
They worship him as God alone.
And crown him — everlasting King.

Jesus, thou everlasting King !
To thee the praise of heaven belong.s ;
Yet, smile on us who fain would bring
The tribute of our humble songs.

Though sin defile our worship here,
We hope ere long thy face to view ;
And when our souls in heaven l^ppear,
We'll praise thy name as angel^ do.

title: CoftiE, ye that love the Saviour's name

stanzas.body:
CoftiE, ye that love the Saviour's name,
And joy to make it known !
The sovereign of your hearts proclaim,
And bow before his throne.

Behold your King, your Saviour, crowned.
With glories all-divine !
And tell the wondering nations round,
How bright these glories shine.

Infinite power, and boundless grace,
In him unite their rays ;
You, that have e'er beheld his face !
Can you forbear his praise ?

review: inferred numbering needs checking against the source

title: When, in his earthly courts, we view

stanzas.body:
When, in his earthly courts, we view
The glories of our Kingj
We long to love as angels do.
And wish like them to sing.

And shall we long and wish in \'ain?
Lord ! teach our songs to rise ;
Thy love can animate the strain.
And bid it reach the skies.

title: Sing to the Lord, ye distant lands

stanzas.body:
Sing to the Lord, ye distant lands!
Ye tribes of every tongue !
His new-discovered grace demands
A new and nobler song.

Say to the nations, — " Jesus reigns,
God's own Almighty Son ';
His power the sinking world sustains,
And grace10 surrounds his throne."

Behold, he comes,— \e comes to bless
The nations, as their God ;
To show the world his righteousness,
And send his truth abroad.

title: Come, shout aloud the Father's grace

stanzas.body:
Come, shout aloud the Father's grace,
And sing the Saviour's love ;
Soon shall you join the glorious theme,
In loftier strains above.

God, the eternal, mighty God,
To dearer names descends ;
Calls you his treasure, and his joy,
His children and his friends.

My Father, God! and may these lips
Pronounce a name so dear ?
Not thus could heaven's sweet harmony
Delight my listening ear.

Thanks to my God for every gift
His bounteous hands bestow ;
And thanks eternal for that love
Whence all those comforts flow.

review: first stanza number missing in scan

stanzas.body:
Come, sound his praise abroad,
And hymns of glory sing ;
Jehovah is tlie sovereign God,
The universal King.

To-day attend his voice,
Nor dare provoke his rod :
Come, like the people of his choice,
And own your gracious God.

Now let our songs arise,
In new exalted strains :
Let earth repeat it to the skies ; —
The Lord, the Saviour reigns !

Sing to the Lord, our God,
And bless his sacred name ;
His great salvation, all abroad,
From day to day proclaim.

Mid heathen nations place
The glories of his throne ;
And let the wonders of his grace
Through all the earth be known.

Great is th' eternal Lord,
And great must be his praise :
O'er all the gods, on high adored,
His mightier arm he '11 raise.

Through earth, let every tribe,
Let every nation, sing :
Glory, and grace, and might ascribe
To our eternal King.

Awake, and sing the song
Of Moses and the Lamb ;
Wake, every heart, and every tongue!
To praise the Saviour's name,

Sing of his dying love ;
Sing of his rising power :
Sing — how he intercedes above
For those whose sins he bore.

Sing on your heavenly way,
Ye ransomed sinners ! sing ;
Sing on, rejoicing, every day,
In Christ, th' eternal King.

Soon shall ye hear him say,
" Ye blessed children ! come ;"
Soon will he call you hence away^
And take his wanderers home.

title: Come, we that love the Lord

stanzas.body:
Come, we that love the Lord !
And let our joys be known :
Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne.

Let those refuse to sing,
That never knew our God ;
But children of the heavenly Kin^
May speak their joys abroad.

The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Or walk the golden streets.

Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry ;
We 're marching through Immanuel's
To fairer worlds on high. [ground
irsz

title: Stand up, and bless the Lord

stanzas.body:
Stand up, and bless the Lord,
Ye people of his choice ;
Stand up, and bless the Lord your God
With heart, and soul, and voice.

Though high above all praise.
Above all blessing high,
Who would not fear his holy name,
And laud, and magnify ?

Oh, for the living flame
From his own altar brought,
To touch our lips, our souls inspire.
And wing to heaven our thought I

God is our strength and song,
And his salvation ours ;
Then be his love in Christ proclaimed
With all our ransomed powers.

Songs of praise awoke the morn
When the Prince of Peace was born ;
Songs of praise arose when he
Captive led captivity.

Heaven and earth must pass away,
Songs of praise shall crown that day ;
God will make new heavens and earth,
Songs of praise shall hail their birth.

And can man alone be dumb.
Till that glorious kingdom come ?
No, the Church delights to raise
Psalms and hymns and songs of praise.

Saints below, with heart and voice,
Still in songs of praise rejoice :
Learning here, by faith and love,
• Songs of praise to sing above.

Hymns of glory, songs of praise.
Father, unto thee we raise ;
Jesus, glory unto thee.
With the Spirit, ever be.
